title: Zonal Incharge
description:
**Position Description**
------------------------



**Business Division:**


AgChem Brands

  

**Department:**

Brand Sales

  

**Location:**
=============


**Multi Location**
==================

  

  

**Position Title:**


Zonal Incharge

  

**Level:**

Sr. Management

  

**Reporting to (Title):**


Cluster Incharge


  

**Position Purpose**
--------------------



The role holder will lead a team of regional in charges and marketing managers and will be responsible for achieving the sales, collection and market penetration targets for the assigned zone. The role is responsible for ensuring review and adherence to zonal sales and accounting processes, dealer processes and new dealer appointments, new product and demand generation initiatives, accurate forecasting and inventory control in coordination with Supply Chain, resolution of customer complaints and other escalated issues.

**Strategic Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* Develop annual sales plan and budgets for the assigned zone (for example, sales revenues by product category, sales realization, new product sales).
* Provide accurate sales forecasts / actual sales data to supply chain to maintain optimal inventory level (for example, by product, by region, by month).
* Devise appropriate strategies \& initiatives for achievement of target sales for the region.
* Collaborate with marketing managers in driving new business opportunities by developing new segments (for example, drip irrigation, biolizer, sand mix).
* Collaborate with marketing managers to identify new crop segment/geographies for long term sustained growth
* Provide required inputs and support to Regional in charges and Marketing managers for conducting demand generation activities like demonstrations, group farmer meetings, etc. (for example, technical inputs, field visits for addressing key farmer groups).
* Advise and provide inputs to Product managers and Marketing Teams on pre launches of new products and for establishing PI as a preferred brand amongst different customer segments (for example, identification of target regions for roll out, feedback on competitor campaigns, collating and providing key customer insights).
* Grow business in the assigned zone by evaluating and appointing of new dealers / distributors in the zone with inputs from the regional and territory in charges (for example, investment potential, technical know\-how, market reach, dealer capability)
* Represent the Business in external forums and associations, as required in the zones.
**Operational Responsibilities**
--------------------------------


**Sales \& Operations Management**

* Review and ensure compliance to sales and dealer processes in the zone, as per procedure (for example, documentation procedures, reconciliation procedures, credit processes)
* Work with Regional In Charges to resolve resource \& budget constraints in the assigned zone.
* Ensure effective implementation of demand generation activities and product training programs for existing products in the zone.Responsible for evaluation of dealer performance and provide necessary feedback for course correction (for example, dealer productivity, adherence to policies and procedures)
* Resolve escalated dealer issues and credit related issues (for example, approvals for credit limits, new dealer agreements)
* Ensure resolution of inventory and stock availability issues from the regions (for example, stock availability, stock reconciliation, expired stocks).
* Organize sales review meetings for the assigned zone to review sales performance and drive corrective actions in order to meet planned targets and resolve any issues faced. (for example, sales, collections, market penetration, inventory issues, dealer issues)

  


**Compliances**

* Ensure compliance to statutory \& organization policies including safety, health, environment in the zone (for example, license renewals, registrations, depot maintenance)

  


**MIS \& Reporting**

* Ensure completion and review of all MIS / Performance reports for the zone (for example, sales, collections, new dealer appointments, expenses, effectiveness of promotion campaigns).

  


**Customer Complaints Management**


* Track and review the status of customer complaints in the zone on a regular basis, and drive resolution as per stipulated turn around times (TAT), in collaboration with the concerned stake holders (for example, production, quality, product development).
**Financial Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* Ensure achievement of planned sales and collection targets for the zone (for example, sales growth, sales realization, dealer development)
* Achieve planned institutional sales targets to Government and allied agencies for institutional business, in collaboration with the concerned stake holders (for example, Institutional Sales \& Exports team)
* Review and ensure adherence to zonal expenses and other accounting related documentation for the zone, as per budget (for example, travel expenses, promotional expenses, budgeted vs. actual expenditure, supporting bills for expenses, accounts reconciliations )


Provide necessary inputs from the zone, for formulation of pricing schemes / feedback on product incentives to the concerned stake holders through appropriate competitor intelligence and market feedback etc.

**People Responsibilities**
---------------------------


* Ensure adequate staffing of the regions, as per staffing plan.
* Review team performance and provide necessary feedback to meet assigned targets.
* Mentor the team to achieve the planned targets and provide support on professional and individual development (for example, technical and behavioral training)
* Review and ensure adherence to initiatives identified for career development of team members (for example, individual development plan, job rotation)
* Identify Hi Potential team members, and drives their IDP execution in collaboration with HR
**Education Qualification**
---------------------------



B.Sc(Agri)/M.Sc(Agri) /MBA

**Work Experience**
-------------------


* 15 to 20 years experience in sales of pesticides and / or other agricultural inputs
* Should have experience of leading large teams of around 50 or more people at the regional level
* Should have handled a business volume of around 50 cr. and above in the earlier role
**Industry to be Hired from**
-----------------------------



Agri Inputs

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------


* Execution Excellence
* Demand Generation
* Sales Planning
* Budgeting
* Digital Proficiency (B)
* Market Intelligence and Product Knowledge
**Interaction Complexity and Team Work**
----------------------------------------



**Interaction**

  

**Frequency**

  

**Purpose of Interaction**

  


**Internal :**

  


* Regional In Charges, Marketing Manager, Product Manager, Head Marketing, Zonal HR, Zonal Accounts, Depot In Charges, Supply Chain and Logistics, Institutional Sales \& Exports ,Production, Product Development
  


As and when required

  


Sales, collections, new Dealer appointments, dealer performance, credit appraisals, expense reporting and accounting, new product launches, promotion of existing products, stock availability and inventory issues, resolution of customer complaints, staffing and other HR initiatives.

  


**External :**

  


* Farmers, Dealers / Distributors, Retailers, Institutions, External forums / associations, marketing vendors
  




As and when required

  


Key farmer meets, customer complaints resolution, dealer reviews, new dealer appointments, feedback of product trials, networking and representation of PI in external forums, review and approvals for marketing promotion.

title: Revenue Compensation Lead
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**


We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Operations Team. **This is the first dedicated compensation headcount in the team** and will play a key role in scaling our compensation operations. This role sits at the intersection of operational rigor and cross\-functional partnership, focusing on administering compensation programs, building scalable processes, and ensuring our GTM teams are paid accurately and on time.


As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate with Legal, HR, Finance, and Sales Leadership to design and maintain the systems, workflows, and governance structures that power our variable compensation programs. This is an exciting opportunity to bring operational depth and analytical expertise to a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


In this role, you will be responsible for:

* **Process Design \& Maintenance** \- Design and maintain scalable processes that support efficient compensation administration, including payout cycles, reconciliations, and operational close processes.
* **Compensation Administration** \- Administer compensation plans, quotas, credits, adjustments, exceptions, and payout processes, ensuring accuracy and consistency across GTM teams.
* **Governance \& Compliance** \- Partner with Legal, HR, and Finance to support approvals, compliance, and audit requirements. Execute compensation letter generation, distribution, tracking, and record management.
* **Reporting \& Analytics** \- Develop dashboards, reports, and quality assurance processes that improve visibility, accuracy, and trust in compensation programs.
* **Field Support** \- Manage compensation\-related inquiries from GTM personnel, streamlining communication between field teams and back\-office functions. Build and maintain support resources, FAQs, documentation, and intake processes.

**Who you are**


We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

* Are **passionate about audio AI** driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.
* Are a **highly motivated and driven individual** with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.
* Are **analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges** with a first principles mindset.
* Consistently **strive for excellence**, delivering high\-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.
* **Take initiative and work autonomously** from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

**What you bring**

* **6\+ years of Compensation Operations, Revenue Operations, or Finance Operations** at high\-growth technology companies
* Demonstrated ability to build and improve scalable operational processes in high\-growth environments.
* Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps
* Foundational analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and process improvement.
* Comfort balancing strategic context with day\-to\-day operational execution.

**What we offer**

* **High\-velocity innovation:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **A truly global team:** Collaboration with teammates across 30\+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)
* **Remote first:** We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.
* **Continuous growth**: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.


This role is remote, so it can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York, London and Warsaw.

Principal Compensation Analyst
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

* Conduct comprehensive market research using external salary surveys (e.g., Mercer, Radford) to gather data on competitor compensation practices for various job roles.
* Analyze market trends and identify industry benchmarks to assess company competitiveness.
* Conduct ad\-hoc market analysis to support specific compensation initiatives.
* Clean, manipulate, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources to generate actionable insights aligned to business strategy.
* Develop detailed reports and presentations showcasing compensation trends, market positioning, and recommendations for salary adjustments.
* Maintain salary ranges based on market data in alignment with company strategy.
* Annually review survey participation and budget and make recommendations for changes.
* Manage the annual survey matching process. Own the relationship with our survey providers. Maintain and enhance our market database.
* Explore new ways of working leveraging AI in benchmarking.


QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

* BA/BS degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related field
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools
* Experience with compensation survey platforms
* Experience with Payfactors is a plus
* Strong understanding of compensation principles and best practices
* Ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
* Knowledge of industry trends and competitive landscape
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively present findings to senior management and HR stakeholders
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams

**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


Employees in the Total Rewards job family are responsible for all processes and teams associated with work across both compensation and benefits including compensation design and management, benefits design and management, executive rewards design and management, reward plan evaluation and analysis, reward plan communication and vendor management. Impact and Contribution Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Leading expert individual contributor who is viewed as a valuable resource by peers. Works to achieve organizational, functional, and/or business targets with measurable impact on department results. Comprehensive knowledge and skills in a professional discipline, understanding the impact of work on related areas.

**About the Role:**


We’re looking for an Accounting Analyst to join our Finance team. In this role, you’ll support accurate financial reporting and efficient accounting operations by preparing journal entries, managing reconciliations, and assisting with treasury activities. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, analytical, and adaptable, with strong organizational and communication skills.


This is a great opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across core accounting processes, contribute to process improvements, and play a key role in ensuring compliance and accuracy in a fast\-paced, growing organization.

 **What You’ll Do:**

* Prepare daily and month\-end journal entries and account reconciliations.
* Process accounts payable and ensure timely, accurate vendor payments.
* Assist with treasury activities, including cash reconciliations and initiation/review of wires and ACH.
* Manage, reconcile, and maintain records of Trust account balances.
* Support the implementation of best practices to simplify, standardize, and scale accounting processes.
* Assist with year\-end audit preparation and documentation.
* Leverage Excel and other firm systems to drive efficiency and process improvements.
* Participate in special projects, system enhancements, and ad hoc analyses as assigned.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (required).
* Familiarity with Business Central is a plus.
* Highly organized, attentive, and able to manage multiple priorities with urgency.
* Flexible and adaptable to changes in procedures and job assignments.
* Capable of working independently with minimal oversight.

**Education \& Experience:**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) fresher.
* Strong academic background in accounting, finance, or related discipline.
* Prior exposure to financial systems or accounting internships is a plus.

title: Solutions Engineer Intern
description:
FlytBase


Every drone deployment starts with a technical conversation across the globe \- you'll learn to own it. Master the art of solving Fortune 500, defense, and industrial customer problems, and turn autonomous systems into real\-world outcomes across six continents.


Solutions Engineering
 Pune, India (Onsite)
 Internship
 Fresher
  
### **What We Do**


FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies. With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


We’re scaling our Solution Engineering team and this role takes you global from Day 1\. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers across six continents, helping Fortune 500s, defense innovators, and industrial leaders deploy autonomous drone systems that change how the world operates. If you’re an early\-career engineer who’s built real projects (robots, drones, AI systems) and wants to solve global\-scale problems, this is your runway. You’ll travel across regions, engage with customers, and shape the future of autonomous operations. This isn’t a support role, it’s a strategic, problem\-solving seat where every decision you make drives technical and business outcomes worldwide.
### **What You'll Own**


• Be the global problem solver: Interact directly with customers across the US, Europe, APAC, LATAM, and the Middle East—understand their toughest autonomy challenges and turn them into executable solutions. • Own technical success: Lead onboarding, testing, deployment, and scaling of FlytBase systems—ensuring smooth, high\-impact rollouts for enterprise operations. • Drive customer conversations: You’ll be the technical face of FlytBase—running demos, guiding architecture discussions, and aligning on automation goals with CXOs and field engineers alike. • Go on\-site worldwide: Be hands\-on with live deployments—from configuring drone docks to testing mission automation in complex industrial environments. • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product and engineering to convert customer feedback into tangible product improvements. • Design scalable workflows: Build automations and drone workflows that deliver measurable ROI for enterprises. • Leverage AI daily: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Rewind, and other AI tools to debug faster, analyze logs, automate responses, and scale your output. • Represent FlytBase globally: Attend trade shows, expos, and customer events to showcase how Physical AI is transforming industries. • Every customer, every mission, every trip—you’ll be operating at the intersection of AI, hardware, and global impact.
### **Best Suited For**


• Fresher or early\-career engineer with a technical background (Electronics, CS, Mechatronics, Robotics, or AI). • You’ve built something real—drones, robots, or AI/IoT systems—during college or internships. • Strong communication skills—you can talk code with engineers and clarity with executives. • Deep curiosity for how AI and autonomy can transform industries. • You take ownership—when something breaks, you fix it; when something’s unclear, you figure it out. Bonus Points • Hands\-on with PX4, ROS, Ardupilot, or DJI SDKs. • Experience using Postman, Python, APIs, or data integrations. • Exposure to AI/ML, computer vision, or autonomous navigation. • Comfortable documenting and explaining complex workflows through guides or videos. • Prior experience testing or flying drones (even hobby projects count).
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• Deep curiosity for Physical AI: You have an insatiable appetite to learn about the Physical AI industry, drone autonomy, and emerging use cases. You're genuinely fascinated by how autonomous systems transform industrial operations. • High learning velocity: We know you might not know everything about our industry from day 1, but you have the grit and curiosity to learn fast. Once you've absorbed the knowledge, you work on autopilot mode (yes, like drones and robots) executing independently with minor course corrections. • Critical thinking \& needle\-moving focus: You think critically about priorities and focus your energy on activities that create real impact. You're not just busy—you're effective. • Ownership without oversight: We won't micromanage your customer conversations. We expect you to own technical outcomes and customer satisfaction, not just demo metrics. You plan milestones, stay proactive with customers, and anticipate their needs rather than just reacting to requests. • High trust, high candor: You give customers honest technical advice even when it's not what they want to hear. You surface implementation challenges early because you care about their success. The same applies internally—you maintain high trust and high candor with team members, giving and receiving direct feedback. • Velocity over perfection: You'd rather ship a working proof\-of\-concept this week than a perfect demo next month—customers buy solutions that solve problems today. • Full\-stack execution: When needed, you'll dive into code, build custom integrations, or jump on\-site for critical deployments. Job descriptions are starting points, not boundaries. • Joy in complexity: Enterprise drone deployments can be chaotic. But you find mazaa (fun) in turning customer confusion into clarity and technical challenges into competitive advantages.
### **What We Don't Want**


• Demo jockeys who celebrate presentation metrics over customer outcomes • "Relationship managers" who avoid getting their hands dirty with technical details • Feature showcasers who demo everything but solve nothing—we need problem solvers, not product tourists • Yes people who agree with every customer request without understanding feasibility, business impact, or the actual problem being solved • Handoff artists who disappear after the sale—we need partners who stay engaged through implementation and beyond • Documentation dodgers who avoid creating clear guides, tutorials, or technical content that scales customer success • Anyone who says "that's not my job" when customers need help • People who confuse being busy with being impactful—we care about customer success, not activity reports • One\-size\-fits\-all consultants who use the same approach for every customer instead of tailoring solutions to specific enterprise environments
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most • Top\-tier health coverage for you • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you're an engineer who wants to go global from Day 1, work with Fortune 500 customers, and learn how enterprise software gets deployed in the real world—this is your shot. FlytBase moves fast. Apply only if you're ready to match that speed.

**Role Overview**
 We're looking for a Data Enthusiast who combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience applying machine learning in production. You'll build and scale data pipelines on Databricks, and partner closely with Data Science/Business Intelligence teams to operationalize models \- from feature engineering through deployment and monitoring as well as generating insights that create business impact
   

  

**Your Profile**
* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Lakeflow/DLT, Unity Catalog)
* Develop and productionize feature pipelines for ML use cases, ensuring reliability, freshness, and reproducibility
* Collaborate with Data Scientists/ML Engineers to deploy models (batch and/or real\-time), including via Databricks Model Serving or ML flow
* Optimize Spark jobs, SQL warehouses, and cluster configurations for cost and performance
* Build and maintain system\-level observability for pipelines and ML jobs (usage, cost, quality, drift)
* Implement data quality checks, testing, and monitoring across the medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold)
* Own Unity Catalog governance for datasets and features — access controls, lineage, and PII masking
* Partner with platform/infra teams on job orchestration, CI/CD for data \& ML pipelines, and cost optimization
* Contribute to architecture decisions around lakehouse design, streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, and tool selection (build vs. buy)
* Perform analysis on top of the data you build, answer ad\-hoc business questions, validate metrics, and spot data quality issues before they reach stakeholders
* Evaluate and apply LLMs/agentic frameworks responsibly within the team, balancing accuracy, cost, and governance (e.g., row/column\-level access control on what an AI agent can query)


**Your Checklist**
* 1\-3 years of data engineering experience working on Databricks in production
* Strong proficiency in PySpark/Spark SQL and Python
* Solid understanding of Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow/DLT, and Databricks system tables (billing, compute, query history) Experience building and maintaining feature pipelines or ML data infrastructure (feature stores, training/serving data parity)
* Familiarity with MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry) and/or Databricks Model Serving
* Strong SQL skills and experience with warehouse performance tuning (query optimization, materialization strategies, cluster sizing)
* Understanding of ML fundamentals — enough to have real conversations with Data Scientists about features, drift, and model lifecycle (you don't need to be building models yourself, but you should understand what "good" looks like)


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with real\-time/streaming architectures (Structured Streaming, Kafka, Lakebase or similar)
* Exposure to LLM/agentic tooling (Databricks Genie, RAG pipelines, vector search)
* Experience with cost governance/FinOps for Databricks workloads

* Familiarity with orchestration tools (Databricks Jobs, Airflow) and CI/CD for data pipelines

title: Academic Career Counselor
description:
Job Description: Career Counselor – EdTech Company

**Job Title:** Career Counselor  
**Department:** Student Success / Admissions  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience Required:** 1–3 years  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamilnadu  
**Salary:** ₹10000 to ₹20000 per month

Job Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic and student\-focused Career Counselor to guide students and working professionals in selecting suitable courses and career paths. The candidate will understand learners’ educational backgrounds, interests, skills, and career goals and recommend appropriate training programs.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and professionals through phone calls, online meetings, and face\-to\-face interactions.
* Understand each learner’s educational background, interests, strengths, and career objectives.
* Recommend suitable technical, placement\-focused, and professional\-development courses.
* Clearly explain course curriculum, duration, fees, certifications, placement assistance, and career opportunities.
* Follow up with prospective learners and support them throughout the admission process.
* Convert qualified enquiries into course enrolments while maintaining ethical counseling practices.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow\-ups, counseling sessions, and enrolments in the CRM.
* Conduct career\-awareness sessions, seminars, webinars, and orientation programs.
* Coordinate with academic, training, marketing, and placement teams.
* Build positive relationships with students, parents, colleges, and institutional partners.
* Collect learner feedback and help improve the counseling and admission experience.
* Achieve assigned monthly counseling and enrolment targets.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Education, Human Resources, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in career counseling, academic counseling, admissions, education sales, or EdTech.
* Freshers with excellent communication and counseling skills may also be considered.
* Good understanding of higher education, skill\-development programs, and employment trends.
* Fluency in English and at least one regional language.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and active\-listening skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and persuasion abilities.
* Empathy and a genuine interest in helping learners build their careers.
* Ability to understand learner requirements and recommend appropriate programs.

Marketing

### **What We Do**


FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies. With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


We're looking for a motion graphics intern who can jump in and start producing from day one—this is a working role, not a shadowing one. You'll be handed real briefs for product explainers, social content, and campaign videos, and expected to take them from concept to final render with the design team's support, not their supervision. You'll also be expected to use AI video and animation tools as part of your everyday workflow to move fast. If you need heavy hand\-holding to get started, this isn't the right fit—but if you're ready to own tasks end\-to\-end and learn on the job by actually doing the job, this is for you.
### **What You'll Own**


• AI\-Native Motion: Use tools like Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Veo 2, and AnimateDiff as part of your daily workflow to generate and refine motion assets. • Multi\-Format Animation: Independently produce motion graphics for social content, product explainers, ads, and internal videos, start to finish. • Storytelling: Turn product and technical ideas into clear, compelling animated content with minimal briefing. • 3D \& Editing: Animate and composite 3D renders and video edits for live campaigns. • Reusable Systems: Use and help build motion templates and design systems the team relies on.
### **Best Suited For**


• Working proficiency in After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent)—comfortable enough to execute independently, not just follow tutorials. • Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video/motion tool, or the ability to pick one up and be productive within days. • A reel of real work—personal, freelance, or college projects—that shows you can take an idea through to a finished, polished piece on your own. • Solid grasp of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling fundamentals. • Comfortable taking a brief and running with it, asking sharp questions instead of waiting to be told each step. • You've seen every corner of Pinterest and have curated boards for all your visual ideas.
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• AI\-first mindset: You already reach for AI tools to move faster, not just when told to. • Ready to ship: You can take a task from brief to final output without needing it broken down for you. • Ownership without oversight: You manage your own tasks and flag blockers early instead of waiting. • High trust, high candor: You give and receive sharp feedback early. • Reliable: You follow through on what you commit to, on time.
### **What We Don't Want**


• Interns looking for a resume line with no real involvement. • People who need step\-by\-step hand\-holding to get started on a task. • Those who avoid AI tools or treat them as optional. • Anyone who confuses hours worked with value created.
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most • Top\-tier health coverage for you • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you're tired of waiting for someone to give you a chance and ready to prove what you can do, let's talk. Send us your portfolio and show us why you're the kind of person who raises the bar.

title: Technical Proofreader / Proofreader
description:
**Job Description – Technical Proofreader**  
**Role Summary**

Proofreaders at Educart are responsible for identifying and correcting grammatical, typographical, formatting, and technical errors in written documents by comparing them with the original manuscripts. The role requires strong attention to detail, knowledge of proofreading standards, and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Read and evaluate written content for grammatical, spelling, punctuation, and typographical errors.
* Compare proofs with original manuscripts to identify inconsistencies and missing content.
* Collaborate with writers and editors to finalize document composition and formatting.
* Verify image dimensions, text spacing, layouts, and positioning according to specifications.
* Ensure page numbering is accurate and no pages are repeated or missing.
* Check whether chapter titles match the table of contents.
* Ensure illustrations, captions, and references are accurate and properly placed.
* Stay updated with grammatical developments and language terminology.
* Coordinate with authors and editors to clarify language or formatting inconsistencies.
* Forward finalized proofread materials for approval and publication.
* Check for missing technical fonts and incomplete portions in documents.

**Skills Needed**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in the publishing industry.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* Good command of Hindi and English languages.
* Strong understanding of proofreading practices, procedures, and publishing standards.
* Proficiency in Adobe Reader and Microsoft Word for proofreading corrections.
* Excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
* Ability to work under strict timelines and manage multiple documents efficiently.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

 Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. title: Business Growth & Operations Intern — Management Track (Paid)
description:
**About Us**

Talkroot Pvt Ltd is a remote\-first omnichannel management and customer support company, with live projects running across India, Dubai, and the USA. We work with international clients and run a lean, high\-performance team spread across India. We're now launching a new project — and looking for a select few interns who want to build a real career, not just add a line to their resume.

This is not an ordinary internship. You'll work closely with the founder and core team, own real responsibilities from week one, and learn how a global operation actually runs.

**What You'll Do**

* Research and identify potential clients; build and manage outreach pipelines
* Reach out to prospects across channels — email, LinkedIn, calls
* Attend client meetings and visits (all travel and expenses fully covered by the company)
* Support core operations: reporting, coordination, CRM, and campaign management
* Learn the business end to end — sales, operations, client management, and delivery

**Who We're Looking For**

* MBA in Marketing, Operations, or HR preferred
* Freshers with an exceptional mindset, natural management ability, and a genuine growth mentality are strongly encouraged to apply
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Self\-driven, coachable, and hungry to learn and grow
* Own laptop and stable internet
* Flexible with working hours — our clients are global, so this is not a fixed 9\-to\-5 or an evening shift; it's anytime, as the work demands

The one question we really care about: **are you willing to learn and grow?** If yes, we want to meet you.

**What You Get**

* ₹6,000/month stipend
* All client\-visit expenses fully paid by the company
* Direct mentorship from the founder and leadership team
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation
* A clear path to a full\-time role with a significantly higher salary for top performers

Pay: ₹6,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Work from home

* Are you fluent in Hindi Yes/No
* Are you comfortable communicating professionally in English with clients? Yes/No
* Are you available to commit to this internship for at least \[3/6] months without leaving midway? Yes/No
* This role can require travel for client visits at short notice, anytime — are you fully flexible to travel whenever the work demands?
* Right now, is building your career your number one priority — above everything else?

description:
**Manager \- Procurement Operations \& Advisory (WBPPS)**


**Job \#:** req37818
  

**Organization:** World Bank Group
  

**Sector:** Procurement
  

**Grade:** GH
  

**Term Duration:** 4 years 0 months  


**Recruitment Type:** International Recruitment
  

**Location:** Washington, DC, United States, Chennai, India or Sofia, Bulgaria
  

**Required Language(s):** English
  

**Preferred Language(s):**
  

**Closing Date:** 8/11/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  

**Description**

**Note:** “This vacancy announcement is for one position posted across multiple possible duty stations. That includes Washington D.C and Sofia and Chennai. The selected candidate's duty station will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs. If the selection is based in Washington, DC, the recruitment type will be International and if the selection is based in Sofia or Chennai, the recruitment type will be Local.”

  

The World Bank Group is a unique global partnership of five institutions driven by a bold vision to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. As one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries, we help solve the world’s greatest development challenges. When you join the World Bank Group, you become part of a dynamic, diverse organization with 189 member countries and 182 offices worldwide. We work with public and private sector partners, invest in groundbreaking projects, and use data, research, and technology to bring tangible and transformative change around the globe. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org


**Vice\-Presidency Context**


The WBG Budget and Procurement (WBP) is organized into five Departments: WBP Centers of Excellence (WBPCE) with teams supporting the corporate strategic business and budget planning process, providing WBP systems, knowledge, and shared services; WBP IBRD/IDA Regional Units (WBPRU) with teams supporting IBRD/IDA clients in the regions; WBP IFC/MIGA Budget Partners (CSRDR) with teams supporting IFC/MIGA clients in the HQ and the regions; WBP Corporate Units (WBPCU) with teams supporting the Knowledge Bank and corporate units and providing capital budget support; and WBP Corporate Procurement (WBPCP) with teams providing group\-wide procurement services.


**Unit Context**


Steps to continue evolving the management structure of WBPCP with its strategic priorities present the opportunity to recruit for an expanded managerial role in the Department. In line with the WBP global footprint strategy and delivery model, the location of the positions may be Washington D.C., Chennai, or Sofia. In accordance with World Bank Group policy, positions in Country Offices, irrespective of level, are subject to local recruitment. Selections to positions outside of Washington D.C. will be LRS. Business needs and candidate preference will be considered in determining the actual location of each of the positions described below:


Manager, Procurement Operations \& Advisory is responsible for all operational and advisory functions within the Corporate Procurement department. These include the Corporate Procurement Service Desk, Order Management, Vendor Management, governance monitoring, systems support and administration, and regional procurement advisory, amongst others. Manages a global team of 35 staff based in the HQ, Global Business Centers (GBC), and in each of the seven regions of the WBG to support the decentralized footprint of WBG clients.


**Duties and accountabilities:**


Manager, WBPPS has the following three areas of responsibility:


**A)Business Management Responsibilities**


* Manage the teams providing planning, budgeting, and performance reporting services; conducting analytical work and providing advisory services in areas of focus (e.g., operations, investments in technology); and providing other services as needed over time.


* Is an active member of the WBP Leadership Team, participates in cross cutting activities, and from time to time, takes on leadership roles in WBP\-wide activities, such as recruitment and other HR initiatives.


* Provides support and advice to the Vice President and the Director of WBP, Corporate Procurement as requested.


**B)Talent Management Responsibilities**


* Manages the unit staff, including recruitment, evaluation, and career development of staff.


* Provides leadership and support to her/his staff to build sustainable finance skills and capacity to effectively deliver WBP services.


* Manages and oversees the engagement and evaluation of technical consultants within the WBPCP unit, as needed.


**C)Budget Management Responsibilities**


* Effectively and efficiently manages his/her unit’s resources, ensuring its effective formulation and input into budget decisions.


* Advocates and drives cost\-effective delivery of business finance services, promoting transparency, simplicity, standardization, and automation.

**Selection Criteria**


The successful candidate should be recognized for an ability to get things done, strategic thinking and execution leadership, reputation and track record leading large business transformation initiatives, being a problem\-solver, and possessing accomplishments relevant to the WBG’s strategic agenda.


The successful candidate will have an active interest in the activities of the World Bank Group, its mission, products and services in addition to having a strong work ethics and unquestionable integrity, and should possess strong leadership in multicultural environment, and analytical abilities as well as excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills adaptable to all audiences, including Board level.


The candidate should have a minimum of a Master’s degree in relevant field/discipline (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, etc.), coupled with a minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in procurement, with a strong track record of success in leading and managing complex procurement operations.


The ideal candidate should also possess as many of the following professional and personal characteristics as possible:


* Deep understanding of procurement principles, practices, and regulations, including international procurement standards.


* Strong strategic orientation and ability to manage successfully large work programs and extensively decentralized teams.


* Demonstrated ability to conceptualize complex issues with future focused systematic thinking and frame problems as actionable issues with ability to develop consensus among diverse constituents.


* Proven ability to balance client concerns with wider corporate concerns as well as proven ability to interact effectively with WBG and external counterparts.


* Proven change integrator with ability to effectively lead and implement complex change management initiatives.


* Strong understanding of the workings of the organizational context including the matrix environment with deep functional knowledge of the challenges of resource deployment in Operations.


* Demonstrated effectiveness in collaboration across the Organization including Operations and Corporate functions and proven ability to build common goals and solutions while managing different views.


WBG Managerial Competencies

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.



**POSITION SUMMARY**  

We're looking for a highly creative and self\-motivated Senior Product Designer to join EarnIn's Financial Intelligence Platform team. This is a structured, quality\-focused group responsible for designing and improving the foundational experiences that power EarnIn's modern platform for financial flexibility and financial wellness for its community members. You'll work closely with product, engineering, design, compliance, risk, and finance partners to define and drive design excellence across core features like bank connectivity, earnings tracking, and repayment experiences. This role bridges deep design leadership with cross\-functional execution, championing both customer and business value while ensuring quality, simplicity, and regulatory compliance. title: APAC Benefits Coordinator
description:
Barracuda is looking for a Regional Employee Benefits Manager to support the accurate, compliant and employee\-focused delivery of benefit programs across assigned countries. This role combines operational benefits administration, employee support, vendor coordination and process discipline to deliver a consistent benefits experience aligned with regional requirements and globalb benefits standards.


This role will act as the first point of contact for employee and manager inquiries related to benefits and will primarily support APAC plan operations and employee lifecycle events. The role will work closely with the Director, Global Benefits and brokers/consultants, who will retain ownership of plan strategy, renewals, and vendor management.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys operational excellence, employee interaction, and building scalable processes in a global environment.

**What You’ll Be Working On**

* **Administer regional benefits programmes**: Deliver day\-to\-day administration for health, wellbeing, retirement, insurance, leave and other employee benefit programmes across assigned countries or markets.
* **Manage enrolment and employee changes**: Process benefit enrolments, life event changes, eligibility updates, employee contributions and data submissions in partnership with HR Operations, Payroll and external providers.
* **Resolve employee and HR enquiries**: Serve as a point of contact for benefits questions, providing clear guidance to employees, managers and HR partners and escalating complex or sensitive matters where needed.
* **Coordinate vendors and brokers**: Work with benefit providers, brokers and internal stakeholders to resolve service issues, track deliverables, support renewals and maintain reliable service delivery.
* **Maintain compliance and governance**: Keep accurate records, support audits, monitor local statutory and regulatory requirements, and help ensure plans are administered in line with company policy and regional obligations.
* **Support communications and continuous improvement**: Contribute to employee communications, open enrolment activities, reporting and process improvements that increase benefits awareness, engagement and operational effectiveness.

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field; or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a similar support role
* Experience supporting APAC benefits programs or working in a multi\-country environment strongly preferred (Australia, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, and India)
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in data management
* Customer\-first mindset with a strong commitment to delivering excellent employee support
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment
* Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information simply
* Experience working with HRIS systems and ticketing tools preferred
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally with HR, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors

 **Scope \& Role Clarity**

* This role is focused on operations, administration, and Tier 1 support
* Plan design, renewals, and vendor strategy will be owned by the Global Benefits team
* The role may expand over time to include additional regional or HR operational support

title: Sr. Manager, Accounting (India)
description:
**About Vercel:**
-----------------



Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what's next.



For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.



Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.



We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like **OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide**. Whether you're building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you'll help define what comes next.

**About the Role:**



Vercel is scaling fast, and the Senior Manager, Accounting will be a critical hire as we build out the financial infrastructure that supports our global growth and path to the public markets. You will own end\-to\-end accounting operations for Vercel's statutory accounting across current and future entities, from monthly close and statutory compliance to audit support and process improvement. Working closely with the Head of Finance, India Center of Excellence, the US\-based Controller and global finance team, you'll bring rigor, ownership, and a builder's mindset to a function that is growing quickly.



This role is fully remote from your home office in India, with regular overlap hours with the US team. You will report to the Head of Finance, CoE who is also based in India.


**What You Will Do:**


* Lead the full\-cycle monthly and quarterly close for Vercel's current and future international entities, setting clear standards for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness in accordance with both local and US GAAP.
* Guide and support accounts payable and accounts receivable teams for correct accounting, manage payroll accounting and intercompany transactions in coordination with the global finance team.
* Own statutory compliance including preparation and supporting filing of FS, auditsTDS/TCS returns,, and coordination with external auditors and tax advisors. Also coordinate with the corporate secretaries for various secretarial compliance.
* Partner with the US\-based Controller and CAO on the global close; prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statements.
* Partner with SOX leader helping with Design, implement, and evolve SOX\-aligned controls and internal accounting policies for the international entities as the business scales amd execute these controls consistently
* Lead close process improvements and accelerate the closing process; identify automation and AI opportunities, simplify workflows, and build scalable infrastructure for the finance function.
* Own the audit relationship for these international entities; preparing materials, answering auditor questions, and keeping audits running smoothly.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Legal, HR, FP\&A, and Revenue Operations on new business initiatives with accounting implications.
* Mentor and develop junior accounting staff as the CoE team grows.
* Support the US GAAP Accounting for the US based entity(s) as and when required in different areas.
* Help the organization in pre and post merger and acquisition activities such as due diligence, integrating the acquired entities, supporting compliance, data migration, etc.
* Lead the new entities setup in different countries representing the accounting team and having these entities operational.
* Monitor changes in local GAAP, tax, regulatory, and corporate compliance requirements for international entities and ensure timely implementation in accounting processes.
* Support cash, banking, treasury accounting, and foreign exchange accounting matters for international entities, including bank reconciliations, revaluations, realized/unrealized FX, and cash reporting.


**About You:**


* 12\+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5\+ years in managing a team.
* CA (Chartered Accountant) designation required; CPA or equivalent international qualification is a plus.
* Deep expertise in technical accounting, including IFRS and US GAAP, with the ability to research, interpret, and apply local GAAP, statutory accounting requirements, tax regulations, and regulatory reporting obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems; NetSuite strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing or supporting Big 4 / top\-tier audits.
* Experience at a high\-growth technology or SaaS company; must have prior exposure to multi\-entity, international accounting structures.
* Process\-minded and curious, with experience leveraging AI, automation, and systems to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Clear, confident communicator who collaborates effectively across remote, cross\-functional, and cross\-cultural teams.
* Self\-starter who thrives in an async\-first environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working in a builder environment where processes may be evolving, documentation may need to be created from scratch, and the role requires both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.


The India annual base pay range for this role is 6,942,000\.00 to 8,678,000\.00 (INR). The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.



Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

title: Factory Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

Multi\-Unit Production Oversight

* **Plan, organize, and monitor day\-to\-day production activities across all assigned** manufacturing units
* Ensure production schedules are met across units while balancing capacity, demand, and resource allocation
* **Travel between units regularly to review performance, conduct audits, and resolve on\-ground issues**
* **Standardize SOPs, processes, and best practices across all units to maintain consistency in output and quality**

Quality \& Compliance

* **Ensure all units comply with FSSAI, food safety, and hygiene regulations**
* Drive adherence to quality control protocols at every stage of production
* **Lead internal and external audits (ISO, FSSAI, customer audits) across units**
* Implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for quality deviations

Team \& People Management

* **Manage unit\-level Plant Managers/Supervisors and their teams across all locations**
* Conduct performance reviews, training, and capability\-building programs for shop\-floor and supervisory staff
* **Drive a strong safety culture and ensure zero\-incident workplace practices**
* Resolve escalations from individual units and ensure consistent HR/IR practices

Cost \& Resource Management

* **Manage budgets, manpower planning, and raw material/inventory across units**
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities in production, utilities, wastage, and manpower utilization
* **Monitor machine uptime, maintenance schedules, and capital equipment needs across** plants
* Optimize production capacity utilization across the unit network

Reporting \& Coordination

* **Consolidate and present production MIS, KPIs, and performance dashboards across all** **units to senior management**
* Liaise with Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, and Sales teams to align production with demand forecasts
* **Drive continuous improvement (Kaizen/Lean) initiatives across the manufacturing** network

Key Skills \& Competencies

* **Strong multi\-site/multi\-unit operations management experience**
* Sound knowledge of food manufacturing processes, FSSAI norms, and quality systems(HACCP, ISO 22000\)
* **Excellent people management and cross\-location team leadership skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* **Proficiency in MS Excel/ERP systems (SAP preferred)**
* Willingness to travel frequently between units

Qualifications \& Experience

* **Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Food Technology, or related field; MBA**
* preferred
* 8–14 years of experience in factory/plant management, with at least 3–4 years managing
* multiple units
* **Experience in FMCG/Food/Sweets \& Confectionery manufacturing preferred(5\-6 years experience)**

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: HR Partner, Ops Field HRP
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.

* 3\+ years of HR generalist, management, or business partner role experience
* Master's degree

title: Employee Relations Manager, INOPS EXR
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work reactively on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field

* 5\+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, supporting users, managing system integrations and working across a broad range of HR technology initiatives.
