description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on CRT, you execute capacity restoration workflows across Amazon’s global network. You troubleshoot link and device failures. You coordinate with cross\-functional teams. You drive TTR down for out\-of\-service capacity. This role is focused on operational execution using existing tools and processes. You work at the component level, solving straightforward problems with guidance from your team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Execute link restoration workflows for Regional Border and Backbone spans.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software failures on network devices.
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on repairs.
* Monitor capacity health using operational event monitoring systems, network health monitoring systems, and workflow orchestration engines.
* Perform device health checks and link tests to validate restoration.
* Maintain accurate records of restoration progress, backlog status, and TTR metrics.
* Identify patterns in recurring failures and escalate to engineering teams.
* Contribute to operational runbooks and process documentation.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Monitor capacity health dashboards and respond to out\-of\-service alerts
* Troubleshoot hardware/software failures on backbone and border network devices
* Execute restoration workflows using established automation and runbooks
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on link repairs
* Document incidents and contribute to post\-event reviews
* Participate in on\-call rotations supporting high severity calls and operational events.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.

title: Freelance Client Acquisition Partner (Commission-Only)
description:
**About the opportunity**  
Srileo Technologies, a Coimbatore\-based software company, is expanding its reach across the city and nearby towns through independent Client Partners. We are looking for well\-connected, self\-driven individuals to introduce our business solution to local businesses. Full details of the product are shared with shortlisted partners.

**The engagement — please read first**  
This is **not** a salaried job. There is **no fixed pay, no attendance, no fixed hours, and no employment relationship.**You work as an independent referral partner under a simple one\-page agreement, at your own pace, and are paid purely on results.

**How you earn**

* A **fixed commission for every client you bring who registers** for our service.
* **No upper limit on earnings** — refer a few clients a month or many, your income grows entirely with your effort.
* Commission is paid once the client completes a free trial and confirms, so only genuine, interested businesses count.

**What you do**

* Introduce our solution to local businesses in your network and area.
* Connect interested businesses with our team — **we handle the demo, setup, and support.**
* You do **not** need a technical background or sales scripts. Your job is simply to open the door; the product proves itself.

**Who this suits**

* People who **already have connections with local business owners and managers** in Coimbatore.
* Self\-motivated individuals who prefer earning by results over a fixed salary.
* Anyone comfortable making warm introductions and following up. Freshers with strong local connections are welcome.

**What we provide**

***Business Development***

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Title :** 
 Senior Manager \- Human Resources \& Organization Development (Manufacturing)
 



  





**About Spruce Up** 




 Spruce Up Industries is a Pune\-based manufacturer of regenerative road sweepers, industrial vacuum machines and municipal cleaning equipment. We have developed machines that compete with established international products and are entering an important industrialization and growth phase.
 



 Our factory is in Pisoli, Pune. We are a hands\-on engineering and manufacturing company: products are designed, built, tested, improved and supported by the same close team.
 



  





**The role** 




 We are hiring our first senior HR leader. This is not a role where you will inherit a large HR department or established corporate systems. You will work directly with the founder and build a practical HR function for a growing manufacturing company.
 



 You will handle both immediate factory HR needs and long\-term capability building: recruitment, employee records, attendance and discipline, supervisor development, appraisals, skill matrices, workforce planning and retention. As the function develops, you will hire and guide a junior Talent Acquisition \& People Operations Executive.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Understand the current organization, employee base and people problems, and establish reliable HR basics.
* Build workforce plans for increased production of road sweepers and existing machines.
* Create a structured hiring process with clear JDs, screening, practical tests and interview scorecards.
* Personally support hiring until a junior talent\-acquisition executive is recruited and trained.
* Coach production supervisors on work allocation, feedback, attendance, discipline and employee development.
* Design a fair appraisal and promotion system based on output, quality, skill, reliability and behavior.
* Create skill matrices and progression paths for various employees.
* Track attrition, absenteeism, offer\-to\-joining and new\-hire retention, and recommend practical solutions.
* Coordinate employee documentation, payroll inputs and statutory HR work with finance or external consultants.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 6\-12 years of broad HR experience, with meaningful manufacturing or engineering exposure.
* Hands\-on experience with shop\-floor employees, technicians, engineers and office staff.
* Evidence of building or substantially improving an HR system \- not only administering one.
* Comfort working in a founder\-led SME where systems are still being created.
* Good Hindi and English; Marathi is strongly preferred.
* Pune\-based and able to work from our Pisoli factory on two fixed days each week, with additional presence when important factory matters require it.



  





**Work arrangement** 




 This is a hybrid role. The normal arrangement is two fixed factory days per week. Other days may be remote or field\-based. Because this is a manufacturing HR role, there will also be occasions when factory presence is required for onboarding, employee relations, appraisals or urgent issues.
 



  





**Why this role is unusual** 




 Direct access to the founder and real ownership of the complete HR function.
 



 Opportunity to build systems from scratch rather than administer a mature corporate process.
 



 Exposure to a technically ambitious Indian machine\-manufacturing company entering a scale\-up phase.
 



 A role that combines practical plant HR with organization building and talent capability.

* Communicate effectively to provide the best possible resourcing solutions.

 here
 
 .

 Amagi's R\&D organisation is the engine of its product roughly 50% of the company sits here, building the technology that powers broadcast and streaming operations for customers globally. * Act as the primary People Partner for all Tech hfunctions and their leadership teams

* Drive the annual performance cycle (Success\-In) end\-to\-end
* Build and maintain succession pipelines for leadership roles
* Identify talent gaps and partner with TA to close them proactively
* Support calibration sessions and ensure rating consistency and fairness across teams
* Lead structured conversations with managers on low performance — Amagi has historically avoided documentation; this role is expected to change that



  





**3/ People and culture** 



* Lead engagement action planning post\-surveys (listening channels)
* Support managers on employee relations issues, including PIPs, restructures, and exits
* Coach first\-time and experienced people managers on leadership effectiveness
* Champion psychological safety and inclusive team practices across engineering functions



  





**4/ Organisational effectiveness** 



* Lead or support org design projects as the Org evolves its structure
* Partner with the L\&D function on capability development for engineering managers
* Contribute to cross\-team People initiatives as part of the broader People Partnering community at Amagi



  





**What are we looking for?** 



* 8–10 years of progressive People Partnering experience, with at least 6 years supporting engineering or product organisations
* Demonstrated ability to partner with VP/Director\-level engineering leaders not just support, but influence.
* Strong working knowledge of performance management, succession planning, and talent calibration
* Experience navigating employee relations issues in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Comfortable working with data; able to read HC trends, attrition patterns, and engagement data and draw business\-relevant conclusions

* Familiarity with OKR\-based goal\-setting frameworks used in product orgs

 Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.
 


* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.** 
 Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.** 
 We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.** 
 We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.** 
 We dream big but execute with relentless precision.



  





**A Place That Takes Care of You:** 




 We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on\-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate.  Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.

Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. **About Clearwater Analytics:**
 Clearwater Analytics (NYSE: CWAN), a global, industry\-leading SaaS solution, automates the entire investment lifecycle. With a single instance, multi\-tenant architecture, Clearwater offers award\-winning investment portfolio planning, performance reporting, data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, compliance, risk, and order management. Each day, leading insurers, asset managers, corporations, and governments use Clearwater’s trusted data to drive efficient, scalable investing on more than $6\.4 trillion in assets spanning traditional and alternative asset types.
   

  

 Our mission: To be the world’s most trusted and comprehensive technology platform that simplifies the entire investment lifecycle and eventually revolutionizes the world of investing.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The HR Business Partner – R\&D APAC will serve as the primary strategic HR partner for Clearwater Analytics’ Research \& Development organisation across the Asia\-Pacific region, covering India (Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida), Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan. Based in Mumbai and reporting to the HR Head of India, this is a senior individual contributor role that partners closely with R\&D leadership to shape and execute a comprehensive people agenda that drives organisational effectiveness, talent excellence, and a high\-performance culture across five dynamic markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Strategic HR Partnership**
* Serves as the primary strategic HR advisor to R\&D senior leadership across India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan — translating business priorities into a cohesive people agenda that supports Clearwater’s engineering and technology growth objectives across the region.
* Engages as a thought leader on APAC people strategy, proactively surfacing regional market intelligence, talent trends, and competitive insights to inform R\&D leadership decisions.


**Talent Management \& Workforce Planning**
* Leads talent management processes for the R\&D APAC population including annual talent reviews, succession planning, career development frameworks, and high\-potential identification across all five markets.
* Partners with Talent Acquisition — APAC to define workforce plans, role architecture, and hiring strategies that meet R\&D scaling goals across India (Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida), Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan.
* Advises on grade\-level structures, technical career ladders, and compensation benchmarking frameworks specific to R\&D roles across diverse APAC talent markets.


**Employee Experience \& Engagement**
* Designs and drives employee engagement strategies tailored to the R\&D engineering population across APAC — identifying root causes of attrition and disengagement through structured listening, pulse surveys, and manager feedback channels.
* Champions a culture of inclusion, recognition, and psychological safety within APAC R\&D teams, partnering with managers on effective onboarding, integration, and long\-term retention of critical engineering talent.


**Performance Management \& Employee Relations**
* Guides R\&D managers through performance calibration, feedback frameworks, and improvement planning, while navigating complex employee relations matters with cultural sensitivity and alignment to local employment laws — including India’s Labour Codes and POSH Act, Singapore’s Employment Act, Australia’s Fair Work Act, Hong Kong’s Employment Ordinance, and Japan’s Labour Standards Act.
* Coaches and upskills APAC R\&D managers on people management fundamentals, navigating difficult conversations, and building high\-performing engineering teams.


**Organisational Design \& Change Management**
* Leads and supports organisational design, workforce restructuring, and change management initiatives within R\&D APAC — ensuring business\-driven decisions are executed with care for employee impact and in compliance with local regulations.
* Collaborates with COEs — Compensation, L\&D, Talent Acquisition, and HR Ops — to localise and deploy people programmes that address the specific needs of a fast\-growing, engineering\-first APAC population.


**HR Programme Leadership**
* Designs and delivers one or more high\-impact people initiatives annually — such as an APAC R\&D retention framework, technical career ladder, or manager capability programme — and represents R\&D APAC in global HR projects and working groups.
* Builds and tracks people strategy metrics for R\&D APAC — including headcount trends, attrition, capability gaps, and engagement scores — reporting regularly to the HR Head of India and R\&D leadership with data\-driven insights and recommended actions.


**Required Skills:**
* Strategic business acumen with the ability to connect people decisions to R\&D engineering outcomes and regional business growth.
* Strong consultancy and influencing skills — able to challenge and advise senior technical leaders with confidence across diverse cultural contexts.
* Hands\-on experience navigating employment legislation in two or more APAC markets (India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan).
* Proficiency in HRIS platforms, particularly Workday; strong analytical capabilities with comfort working with HR data, dashboards, and people metrics.
* Skilled in change management, facilitation, and executive communication across time zones and cultures.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills; collaborative with proven relationship\-building ability across geographies and seniority levels.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities; project management proficiency with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; MBA or Master’s in HRM strongly preferred.
* SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or equivalent professional HR certification is an advantage.
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 6–7 years in a dedicated HRBP role supporting Engineering, Product, or Technology functions in a global organisation.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior R\&D or technology leadership in a high\-growth, multi\-geography SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated experience managing employee relations, organisational design, and talent management across multiple APAC jurisdictions; prior exposure to India plus at least one other APAC market (Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, or Japan) strongly preferred.


**Employee Benefits:**
* Employee Health Insurance and Wellness program.

* Competitive salary, benefits, and special allowances in the compensation package.
* Continual learning and development opportunities for career growth.

title: Deel
description:
The verdict
   

  

 Deel is the platform to reach for when your hiring crosses borders and you want one login to handle payroll, compliance, and employment law in countries where you have no entity. The global\-payroll and multi\-country compliance are genuinely best\-in\-class, and the free HR Core (up to 200 employees) is rare value. Budget for the all\-in cost, though: EOR starts at $599 per employee per month before employer taxes and FX, and the support experience and people\-management depth are the weak spots.
   

  

 Key features
   

  

 Global payroll across 150\+ countries
   

  

 Runs payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers in one platform, with automated local\-compliance updates, statutory tax handling, and multi\-currency FX payouts.
   

  

 Employer of record (EOR)
   

  

 Hire full\-time staff in countries where you have no legal entity. The quoted EOR price covers onboarding, local compliance, payroll, tax filings, benefits administration, and ongoing HR and legal support.
   

  

 Built\-in US payroll
   

  

 Calculates and files payroll taxes with the IRS and local, state, and federal agencies across all 50 states, and auto\-generates, files, and distributes year\-end W\-2s. Monthly, semi\-monthly, or bi\-weekly cycles, with off\-cycle runs at no extra charge.
   

  

 Free HR Core (HRIS)
   

  

 Worker profiles, time tracking, time\-off and approvals, and document management, free for organizations up to 200 employees. Approvals and requests can be handled directly or through Slack and Teams.
   

  

 Benefits administration
   

  

 Consolidates benefits in a single HR system with automated payroll\-synced deductions and employee\-managed enrollment, connecting to providers including Employee Navigator and Human Interest (401k).
   

  

 Deel Engage and integrations
   

  

 Performance reviews, goals/OKRs, and L\&D in one module, plus automated data flow from Workday, SAP, Oracle, Okta, BambooHR, HiBob, and NetSuite, and a flexible API for custom integrations.
   

  

 What it is
   

  

 Deel is a single platform for employing people in places where you don’t have a legal entity. It runs global payroll across 150\+ countries, acts as the employer of record (EOR) so you can hire a full\-time employee in a country where you have no presence, manages contractors and their contracts, and runs US payroll with the IRS and state filings built in. Underneath all of that is an HRIS, worker records, time off, document management, that ties the payroll and hiring pieces together.
   

  

 The reason it exists is compliance. When you pay someone in another country, you inherit that country’s tax rules, statutory benefits, and labor law. Deel’s pitch is that it absorbs that for you: contracts adapt to local labor laws, payroll calculations reflect local statutory requirements, and the compliance engine updates as regulations change. The company says it operates owned entities in 130\+ countries rather than leaning on third\-party processors, and it carries SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance.
   

  

 Who it’s for
   

  

 Deel is built for the company hiring across borders. If you have engineers in three countries, a contractor in a fourth, and a US payroll to run, this is the kind of tool that collapses four headaches into one login. The further your hiring spreads, the more sense it makes.
   

  

 It is also a genuinely good deal at the entry point if you stay on the free side. Deel HR, the HRIS core covering worker profiles, time tracking, and document management, is free for organizations up to 200 employees. A growing company can run its people data on that for a long time without paying Deel a cent.
   

  

 Who it’s not for: the bootstrapped startup hiring one or two international contractors. The platform is priced for breadth, and at small scale the fees outweigh the convenience. You’ll feel that in the contractor rate and again in the withdrawal and FX charges. If global employment isn’t actually your problem, Deel is a heavier tool than you need.
   

  

 Why it stands out
   

  

 Global payroll and multi\-country compliance are the real strength, and reviewers back this consistently. G2 users credit Deel with handling 130\+ countries through localized contracts, automated tax handling, and built\-in compliance workflows that mean you don’t have to learn foreign labor law or stand up a local entity. This is the thing Deel is actually for, and it’s the thing people rate highest.
   

  

 Onboarding is the second genuine win. Capterra reviewers (4\.8 out of 5 across more than 4,000 verified reviews, with ease of use rated 4\.8\) describe onboarding as fast, simple, and clean, with quick contract creation and signing for both employees and contractors. One recurring line captures the appeal: Deel feels like a legal team, payroll department, and benefits administrator in one platform. February 2026 added a structured Guided SMB Onboarding framework aimed at getting smaller customers to value faster.
   

  

 The free HR Core is the third. For a 200\-person ceiling, getting a real HRIS at no cost is rare, and independent reviewers single it out as excellent entry\-level value.
   

  

 Pricing in plain language
   

  

 The free tier is the headline: Deel HR (the HRIS) costs nothing up to 200 employees. That covers the day\-to\-day people\-data work for most growing teams.
   

  

 Everything that touches money or legal employment is paid, and the gap between tiers is large. Contractor management starts at $49 per contractor per month. US Payroll runs from roughly $19 per employee per month, with monthly, semi\-monthly, or bi\-weekly cycles and off\-cycle runs at no extra charge. US PEO starts at $125 per employee per month. The big number is EOR (employer of record) at $599 per employee per month. That EOR price is quoted as all\-in: Deel states it covers onboarding and local compliance, payroll processing and tax filings, benefits administration, and ongoing HR and legal support, with no surprise fees.
   

  

 Two things to know before you sign. First, the $599 is Deel’s fee, not your total cost. Independent reviewers point out that true cost adds 20 to 40% or more on top once you account for employer taxes, social contributions, mandatory benefits, and FX. That’s the cost of the employment itself, not a Deel markup, but it’s real money you need to budget. Second, the upgrade wall is the jump from free HR Core into paid modules and EOR. The advanced people\-management features (performance reviews, OKRs) sit in paid tiers ($22 to $56 per employee per month), and the moment you need someone legally employed abroad, you’re at EOR pricing.
   

  

 Limitations
   

  

 Cost is the loudest complaint, and it’s not just the headline EOR figure. Reviewers across G2, Capterra, and independent reviews flag withdrawal and transfer fees as high and sometimes unclear, and note that the exchange rates aren’t always as competitive. For a platform whose whole job is moving money across currencies, that’s the friction people feel most.
   

  

 Support is the second weak spot. Capterra reviewers describe inconsistent, slow support and, pointedly, a circular AI support bot that delays reaching a human agent. When you’re dealing with someone’s paycheck, slow communication is the wrong place to cut corners.
   

  

 The third is depth in the people\-management modules. Deel Engage covers performance reviews, goals, and L\&D, and it’s competent, but independent reviewers say it isn’t as deep as dedicated tools for advanced performance workflows or analytics, and Capterra reviewers keep asking for more detailed payroll and expense reporting. The mobile app is the other persistent gripe: slow to load, and particularly sluggish on Android.
   

  

 The bottom line
   

  

 If you’re hiring across borders, yes. Deel does the hardest part of global employment, staying compliant in countries you don’t operate in, better than almost anyone, and the onboarding and payout experience is fast enough that people forgive a lot. The gold\-standard reputation among reviewers for comprehensive global employment is earned.
   

  

 Go in clear\-eyed on two things. Budget for the all\-in cost, not the sticker price: EOR plus employer taxes and FX is meaningfully more than $599\. And don’t expect best\-in\-class performance management or analytics; if those are your priority, you’ll bolt on a dedicated tool. For everyone else, the play is obvious: run the free HR Core while you can, and upgrade into payroll and EOR only when your hiring actually crosses a border.
   

  

 What people are saying online
   

  

 Users come away impressed by Deel's reach and how little friction there is in actually paying people across borders. The praise clusters around speed: fast onboarding, fast contract signing, fast payouts, and a clean interface that does not make global compliance feel like a chore. The grumbling clusters around money and support: withdrawal and transfer fees that feel higher than they should, exchange rates that aren't always competitive, a sluggish mobile app, and a support experience that can dump you into an AI bot loop before you reach a human. Deel lands best for companies hiring full\-time staff or contractors in several countries who want one platform to handle the legal mess. A startup hiring one or two contractors will feel the pricing more than the benefit.
   

  

 Drawn from independent reviews and discussions, separate from our methodology score.
   

  

 What people love
   

  

* Handles 130\+ countries with localized contracts and automated tax/compliance, removing the need to set up local entities
* G2
* Fast, simple onboarding and quick contract creation and signing
* Capterra
* Clean, intuitive interface that makes global payroll and contractor management feel like one place
* Multiple
* Fast, reliable payouts and efficient salary transfers
* G2
* Excellent entry\-level value on free HR Core for teams up to 200 people
* Independent reviews


 Common complaints
   

  

* Premium pricing (EOR from $599/employee/month plus 20\-40%\+ in employer taxes and FX) feels steep for small teams and startups
* Multiple
* High and sometimes unclear withdrawal and transfer fees, with exchange rates that aren't always competitive
* Multiple
* Slow, inconsistent support and a circular AI bot before you reach a human agent
* Capterra
* Mobile app is slow to load, especially on Android
* Multiple
* Performance reviews, reporting, and analytics aren't as deep as dedicated HR tools

* Ability to work autonomously
* Excellent listening, communication and negotiating skills
* The ability to assert point of view directly yet tactfully
* The ability to operate with complete professionalism and confidentiality
* Self\-driven with the ability to multi\-task
* The ability to work outside of normal business hours, when required
* Has the attitude and willingness to undertake further development with Sofitel.

 This role partners with Nike Technology leaders, Human Resources teammates, managers, employees, local Talent Acquisition leaders, and Center of Excellence (COE) partners across Compensation, Talent, Organization Effectiveness, People Solutions, and Talent Acquisition. The role helps shape and execute people strategies that enable the India Technology Centre to grow, scale, and perform at its best.
   

  

**Who We Are Looking For**
 Nike is looking for a Human Resources Business Partner who thrives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment and can translate business priorities into actionable people strategies. This individual brings deep Human Resources expertise, strong business acumen, and the ability to lead through complexity with clarity and confidence.
   

  

 They build trusted relationships with senior leaders and managers, leverage data and employee insights to inform decisions, and develop practical solutions across talent, organization design, rewards, change management, performance, and team effectiveness. They are a coach, connector, and catalyst who can influence across a global matrix while maintaining a strong understanding of local business needs.
   

  

 They bring resilience, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to help scale the India Technology Centre while strengthening organizational capability, culture, engagement, and performance.
   

  

* 15\+ years of relevant Human Resources experience in multicultural, matrixed organizations, including 5\+ years as a business partner supporting sizeable businesses and leadership teams.
* Master’s degree in Human Resources or related field.
* Deep expertise in at least one to two Human Resources domains, such as Rewards, Human Resources Transformation, Talent, Organization Development, Organization Effectiveness, or Operations.
* Proven ability to provide Human Resources consulting, facilitation, coaching, and manager capability\-building while earning credibility with business leaders.
* Strong change, execution, results, and people agility, with the ability to plan, pivot, solve talent challenges, and collaborate across diverse teams.


**What You’ll Work On**
 You’ll partner with Human Resources leadership and Nike Technology teams to scale the India Technology Centre, translate strategy into focused people plans, and help leaders build high\-performing teams that deliver results with speed, alignment, and purpose.
   

  

* Partner with India Technology Centre leaders, including Directors, Senior Directors, and Managers, to align global programs, talent decisions, and business priorities across the organization.
* Help leaders navigate complexity across geographies, technology domains, and organizational priorities by addressing local needs and shaping people solutions with measurable business impact.
* Lead and support talent practices across selection, development, succession, retention, upskilling, and engagement to build capability for future growth.
* Drive organization design, change management, leadership assimilation, and team effectiveness initiatives that enable squads to operate with agility, clarity, and shared accountability.
* Use data, market insights, and employee feedback to coach leaders and influence sound decisions across talent, rewards, performance, and organization effectiveness.
* Build strong partnerships with Human Resources teammates, People Solutions consultants, COE partners, and Talent Acquisition teams to deliver people initiatives with consistency, scalability, and local relevance.
* Shape meaningful employee experiences and support career growth, leadership development, and culture\-building initiatives that help teams succeed together.

title: Workforce Planning Specialist
description:
**Why This Role Matters:**
 At Visteon, we are reimagining how talent, cost, and productivity come together to power the business of the future. The Workforce Architecture team is at the heart of this evolution \- shaping how work gets done and enabling leaders to make thoughtful, high\-impact decisions on where to invest and how to unlock capacity for what matters most.
   

  

 We are looking for a person who is energized by working at the intersection of data, strategy, and business impact. This role is for someone who is curious, analytical, and driven to solve complex enterprise challenges—translating insights into actions that meaningfully shape business outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Own \& Lead**
* Drive AI\-Powered Workforce Transformation:
* Build and own a dynamic Role Risk Register, evaluating how AI and automation impact roles across the organization
* Turn complex data into clear insights that guide reskilling, redeployment, and workforce evolution
* Partner with Talent teams to future\-proof critical skills and roles
* Workforce Investment \& Un\-investment Architecture
* Shape where the company hires, invests, or optimizes workforce capacity
* Evaluate new hiring needs against business priorities, internal talent, and automation potential
* Help leadership make high\-impact decisions on cost, productivity, and talent allocation
* Build Forward\-Looking Workforce Intelligence:
* Lead development of 12–36 months’ workforce forecasts integrating demand, skills, hiring, and attrition
* Provide regular insights on talent gaps, surpluses, and hiring priorities
* Create scalable analytics engines that improve planning accuracy and agility
* Enhance Organizational Effectiveness:
* Drive initiatives to simplify and optimize the organization—spans, layers, and role alignment
* Lead reviews that unlock productivity, capacity, and operational efficiency
* Translate data into clear recommendations leaders can act on immediately


**What You’ll Achieve In Your First Year**
* Deliver a complete AI impact assessment across all roles with actionable reskilling plans
* Build a workforce investment framework that identifies measurable optimization opportunities
* Launch a predictive workforce intelligence engine for long\-term planning
* Drive organization design improvements that increase productivity and free up capacity


**How Success Will Be Measured**
* Full visibility into AI risk across roles with strong mitigation execution
* Tangible ROI and workforce optimization outcomes
* Improved forecasting accuracy (\~±5%)
* Significant redeployment of talent to meet new business demand


**What You Bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in workforce planning, resource management, or engineering operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills (strategy, finance, analytics, or consulting background)
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders through clear, data\-driven storytelling
* Ability to evaluate trade\-offs, scenarios, and financial implications
* Focus on business outcomes (capacity, productivity, cost efficiency) over activity metrics.

title: Data Engineer
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We're passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. We believe that a modern design tool should be lightweight and easy to use, with low friction and amazing performance. We are reimagining the creative process powered through a highly collaborative experience that works seamlessly across multiple surfaces. We favor excellence over shortcuts, and quality over scope as we build products for the next decade and beyond. As an engineer on this team you would be designing and building tools and features for designers, pushing the technology boundaries of what is possible on the web. If you're looking to be part of a team that is building the data systems and services that power the web, welcome to Creative Cloud.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain data pipelines on Azure Databricks using Apache Spark and Python, covering both batch and real\-time workloads.
* Write and optimize SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and analytics workloads.
* Help develop and maintain analytics\-ready data models (fact tables, dimensions, rollups, metric layers, and gold layer tables) used for dashboards and reporting.
* Support performance, reliability, and cost efficiency of Databricks workloads, including tuning Spark jobs and Delta Lake tables, and applying good practices like incremental/idempotent processing, MERGE patterns, and partitioning.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders—including product managers, data scientists, business analysts, and engineers—to build solutions that enable reliable, self\-serve analytics.
* Implement data quality checks, validation, and monitoring to help ensure accurate and trusted analytics metrics.
* Follow and contribute to data engineering best practices, including version control and documentation.
* Design and develop new features and tools in collaboration with other engineers, product managers, designers, and user researchers.
* Contribute to solutions that integrate structured and unstructured data, including selective use of GenAI/LLM\-based capabilities where relevant.
* Grow with the support of your team, and support your teammates in turn by sharing feedback and pitching in where you can.
* Be part of building an inclusive team that welcomes diverse opinions.
* Work closely with customers to understand their workflows and needs, and adapt quickly based on their feedback.
* Be part of a team that works like a startup inside Adobe, giving you the best of both worlds.


 What you need to succeed
   

  

* Based in Bangalore.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science.
* 1\+ years of software development experience.
* Strong CS fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python; working knowledge of Node.js and REST APIs.
* Some experience with, or strong interest in, data pipelines and data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark, Kafka, or similar).
* Foundational understanding of data modelling and data warehousing, ideally with some hands\-on exposure to relational and columnar databases.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including curiosity about integrating ML/LLM models into data systems.
* Familiarity with observability tools like Grafana, Splunk, or Prometheus is a plus.
* Exposure to container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Some familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud services and basic cloud security concepts.
* A genuine interest in learning new technologies quickly.
* A thoughtful approach to problem\-solving, with a drive to improve processes and keep learning.
* Good verbal and written communication skills; able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience developing for multiple devices and platforms.
* Experience with Agile development processes.
* Some hands\-on experience with prompting or building data pipelines for LLM workflows.
* A good sense of humour!


**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call \+1 408\-536\-3015\.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
   

  

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

title: Shopify Developer (Fresher to 5 Years)
description:
**Company Overview**
 We are a talent acquisition and staff augmentation firm, and we are currently hiring on behalf of one of our clients. Our client is looking to onboard a
 **Shopify Developer** 
 across multiple locations in India for a remote/hybrid role that can be offered on a
 **full\-time, part\-time, or contractual basis** 
 , depending on the candidate’s preference and eligibility.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Shopify Developer who can build, customize, and maintain e\-commerce storefronts that are fast, reliable, and easy for customers to shop on. This role is open to candidates ranging from
 **early\-career developers to seasoned Shopify experts** 
 , and involves everything from theme customization and app integration to performance optimization and ongoing store maintenance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, work on Shopify themes both in creating new ones or customizing existing ones.
* Set up and configure Shopify stores, collections, products, and checkout flows.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Shopify apps and third\-party integrations.
* Optimize store performance, page load speed, and mobile responsiveness.
* Implement and maintain custom features using the Shopify API and Shopify Plus tools, where applicable.
* Integrate and Embed payment gateways, shipping solutions, and inventory management systems.
* Debug and resolve issues related to themes, apps, and store functionality.
* Collaborate with designers and marketing teams to implement UI/UX changes and campaign pages.
* Monitor store uptime and security, and apply fixes or updates as needed.
* Stay current with new Shopify features, apps, and best practices.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hold on Shopify theme development using Liquid.
* Well versed with commands of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Familiarity with Shopify’s admin panel, apps ecosystem, and Shopify API.
* Understanding of responsive design and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of version control tools such as Git.
* Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.


 AI Experience
   

  

* Comfort using AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to speed up development and debugging.
* Exposure to AI\-powered personalization or chatbot apps within the Shopify ecosystem is a plus, though not mandatory.


 Managerial Experience
   

  

* This is primarily an individual contributor role; prior team\-handling experience is not required.
* For senior candidates, experience guiding junior developers or reviewing their code is a plus.


 Operational Experience
   

  

* Experience maintaining a live e\-commerce store, including regular updates, bug fixes, and uptime monitoring.
* Familiarity with handling store migrations, backups, and rollback procedures.
* Comfortable working within agreed turnaround times for fixes and feature releases.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with relevant hands\-on experience.
* 0–5 years of experience in Shopify or web development; freshers with strong project work are welcome to apply.


 Certifications
   

  

* Shopify Partner or Shopify theme development certification (preferred, not mandatory).

description:
Full\-time
   

  

 Bangalore
   

  

 AI Builder: Models \& Agents
   

  

**Job Description**
 Build the models that turn AI into real outcomes.
   

  

 You’ll ship machine learning and generative AI into live products. You’ll be closest to the problem, earliest to adapt and fastest in your learning.
   

  

 Key focus areas
   

  

 Model development \& fine\-tuning
   

  

* LLMs \& generative AI
* Voice \& audio models
* Production ML pipelines


 What you'll do

 accurate

* Support the development of policies, threat models, dashboards, and reports within the Securonix platform.
* Perform quality assurance testing of detection content before production release.
* Validate detection logic using sample logs, test cases, and documented attack scenarios.
* Document detection logic, assumptions, test results, and known limitations clearly.
* Stay updated on emerging threats, threat research, detection techniques, and community\-published security content.
* Collaborate with Detection Engineers to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical knowledge.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Basic understanding of operating systems, networking concepts, and security fundamentals.
* Ability to read and analyze logs from systems, applications, network devices, or security tools.
* Basic scripting or automation skills, preferably using Python.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn detection engineering, SIEM concepts, and threat detection methodologies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




  




* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as malware, phishing, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and data exfiltration.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms or log management tools.
* Awareness of MITRE ATT\&CK tactics and techniques.
* Exposure to JSON, regex, SQL, APIs, or data parsing.
* Academic projects, internships, labs, certifications, or hands\-on practice related to cybersecurity, log analysis, or scripting.

 We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled NOC Engineer to join
   

  

 our 24x7 Operations team. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience
   

  

 in monitoring production environments, managing incidents, and ensuring
   

  

 service availability while working in a fast\-paced operational environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Monitor production infrastructure and applications using Datadog to


 proactively identify, investigate, and respond to alerts.
   

  

* Handle production incidents across different severity levels and ensure


 timely resolution in accordance with defined SLAs.
   

  

* Act as an Incident Commander for high\-severity (SEV) incidents by leading


 bridge calls, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, driving incident
   

  

 resolution, and providing regular stakeholder updates.
   

  

* Perform incident triaging, impact assessment, escalation, and coordination


 until service restoration.
   

  

* Create, update, and manage JIRA tickets for incident tracking, assignment,


 and closure.
   

  

* Coordinate and facilitate Change Approval Board (CAB) calls by reviewing


 planned changes, validating implementation readiness, assessing operational
   

  

 risks, and ensuring adherence to change management processes.
   

  

* Monitor production systems during and after change implementations to


 identify and mitigate any operational impact.
   

  

* Provide timely and accurate communications to stakeholders during incidents


 and planned maintenance activities.
   

  

* Collaborate with Engineering, Development, Infrastructure, and Support


 teams to resolve production issues efficiently.
   

  

* Ensure proper shift handovers, maintain operational runbooks, and update


 knowledge base documentation.

 continuous service improvement initiatives.

 management.

 environment.
   

  

* Proven experience handling Severity (SEV) incidents and serving as an

* Experience coordinating and managing CAB (Change Approval Board) calls and


 change implementation activities.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Join Our Team as a Senior Security Engineer!**
 Do you want to be part of a
 **global team delivering one of the most successful engineering and security solutions** 
 ? Are you passionate about protecting systems, data, and people? If yes, this opportunity is for you!
   

  

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
* Impact: Your work will directly safeguard critical infrastructure and sensitive information across global operations.
* Innovation: Work with cutting\-edge security tools and technologies in a multi\-sourcing environment.
* Growth: Continuous learning, certifications, and career advancement opportunities.
* Global Exposure: Collaborate with teams across Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with opportunities for travel and interaction with diverse cultures.
* Latest Technology: Be part of a forward\-thinking organization leveraging modern security frameworks.


**About Us**
**Assa Abloy Group IT** 
 manages shared infrastructure and global applications for ASSA ABLOY, as well as selected divisional solutions. We operate in a multi\-sourcing setup, ensuring world\-class service delivery and innovation.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 As a
 **Senior Security Engineer** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining
 **Global Web Security services and Remote access** 
 , with a primary focus on
 **Cloudflare Web Security** 
 and
 **Cloudflare Zero Trust Network Access** 
 solutions. This role emphasizes technical expertise in securing web applications and remote access, ensuring operational resilience, and driving automation and optimization across global environments.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal teams, product SMEs, and operations to enhance security posture, improve efficiency, and ensure compliance with corporate security standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and maintain a global web security architecture leveraging Cloudflare technologies.
* Implement and enforce security policies, standards, and best practices across web and VPN services.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex security incidents and troubleshooting.
* Perform continuous monitoring, vulnerability assessments, and configuration hardening.
* Optimize Cloudflare Access for secure remote access and identity\-based controls.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks.


**Internal Responsibilities**
* Investigate and respond to web security incidents and breaches.
* Stay current with emerging threats, Cloudflare innovations, and Zero Trust frameworks.
* Collaborate with IT and business teams to ensure security measures meet evolving requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cloudflare Zero Trust Network Access , Secure Web gateway or similar technology.
* Deep understanding of web security protocols (HTTPS, TLS, DNS security) and Zero Trust principles.
* Familiarity with automation tools and scripting for security operations.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST) and secure architecture design.
* Relevant certifications (CCNA, CCNP, ITIL, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIASecurity\+) are a plus.
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.


**Work Requirements**
* Ability to work in a global environment and travel as needed.
* Highly organized, proactive, and technically driven with a focus on security excellence.


**Location**
 Chennai, India and Krakow, Poland
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 Be part of a
 **winning team** 
 that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Your role will make a real difference in securing the digital world.
   

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
   

  

 As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Network Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you bring experience and autonomy to own end\-to\-end capacity restoration for assigned network segments. You drive complex troubleshooting across multiple failure domains, mentor engineers, define and improve operational processes, and partner with engineering teams to address systemic resilience gaps. You apply correct technologies and best practices to complex problems, and your scope of influence spans the full team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Execution**
* Own capacity restoration outcomes for assigned network segments, driving TTR reduction and backlog elimination.
* Lead complex, multi\-party troubleshooting for link and device failures spanning carriers, colocations, and internal teams.
* Participate in war rooms for critical events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


**Process And Operations Improvement**
* Define and improve operational processes and runbooks for restoration workflows.
* Analyze restoration metrics (TTR, backlog depth, network health score impact) to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Drive vendor accountability for carrier and colocation\-related restoration delays.


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Partner with Topology Engineering, Capacity Engineering, and fabric engineering teams to address systemic issues.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.


**Mentorship And Development**
* Mentor and develop Network Engineers, providing technical guidance and review.
* Contribute to hiring loops and technical assessments.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Lead complex capacity restoration events involving multiple network layers and cross\-region links.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and develop remediation plans for recurring failures.
* Improve operational processes, runbooks, and escalation procedures based on observed patterns.
* Mentor engineers and conduct knowledge transfer sessions.
* Coordinate with engineering teams on platform readiness and design validation.
* Drive vendor and carrier accountability for restoration delays.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.
* Participate in war rooms for major events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. description:
**Title: Automation \& Robotics Engineer – Battery Swap Station \| Blinq Mobility** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon / Manesar
 



 Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Blinq Mobility is an IIT Delhi–founded EV startup building modular electric microcars with automated battery\-swapping technology. We're redefining urban mobility through innovation, safety, and sustainable engineering, and have built and demonstrated India's first automated 4\-wheeler battery\-swap station.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for an Automation \& Robotics Engineer to take ownership of our battery\-swap station program. You'll inherit a working v1 station (sub\-3\-minute swap, validated on a live Vehicle) and lead the development of Swap Station v2, a universal, multi\-vehicle station running 16 coordinated motors over EtherCAT, RS485, Ethernet with cloud telemetry.
 



  





 You'll work cross\-functionally with mechanical, vehicle electronics, and product teams to bring the station from prototype to deployment.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Own the full automation \& electronics stack of the swap station, PLC ladder logic, HMI, sensors, actuators, and safety interlocks
* Architect and implement EtherCAT, rs485, and Ethernet\-based motion control (servo and stepper drives)
* Design and integrate mechatronic subsystems: lead\-screw lifts, battery carriages, alignment systems, and end\-of\-arm tooling.
* Size and select drives, motors, and gearing via torque/RPM, load, and duty\-cycle analysis.
* Build cloud telemetry and remote diagnostics for fleet\-level station uptime monitoring.
* Define and execute commissioning, fault\-recovery logic, and field\-validation cycles on live vehicles.
* Coordinate with mechanical, firmware, and vehicle integration teams to close out the v2 build.
* Lead vendor sourcing and BOM costing for automation components (drives, controllers, sensors, structural).
* Document the system end\-to\-end, schematics, ladder logic, HMI screens, and commissioning procedures.



  





**Qualifications** 
 :
 


* B.Tech / M.Tech in Mechatronics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation \& Control, or related.
* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, robotics, or motion control.
* Strong working knowledge of PLC programming (ladder logic), HMI design, and industrial fieldbuses (EtherCAT preferred; CAN/Modbus acceptable).
* Experience sizing and commissioning servo/stepper drives.
* Comfort with electrical schematics, panel design, and safety interlock standards.
* Bonus: exposure to EV systems, high\-voltage safety, cloud/IoT telemetry stacks, or robotics frameworks.



  





 Startup mindset, comfortable owning ambiguity, getting hands dirty on the shop floor, and shipping under timeline pressure.
 



  





 Let's build ⚡🚀

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Lyzr**
 Lyzr is a full\-stack AI agent infrastructure platform — we help enterprises and developers build, deploy, and manage AI agents at scale. We move fast, ship fast, and expect the same from the people who join us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an Associate Product Manager for the core platform team who doesn't need a playbook handed to them. This isn't a role where you'll be told exactly what to do every day — you'll be expected to look at a problem, figure out what matters, and drive it to a decision or a shipped outcome. If you've built something before (a side project, a startup, a feature, anything with your fingerprints on it end\-to\-end) and you're comfortable making calls without waiting for permission, this is for you.
   

  

 You'll work closely with the product team across roadmap, execution, and customers. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility seat, not a support role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work directly with engineers and developers to get things scoped, unblocked, and shipped
* Help manage and prioritize the product roadmap
* Partner with the Product team on planning, translating strategy into a real, sequenced plan of action
* Write clear PRDs, user stories, and specs that engineering can pick up and run with
* Get in front of customers, understand their problems, not just their requests
* Join demo calls and speak credibly about the product
* Answer product questions from customers, partners, and internal teams
* Track feature performance and usage post\-launch, and feed learnings back into the roadmap
* Run competitive research and stay on top of what's happening in the market
* Take on ambiguous, undefined problems and figure out how to move them forward
* A lot more that won't fit neatly into a bullet list — the role will grow with you


**What We're Looking For**
* 1–3 years of experience, as a product manager ideally with some exposure to product, tech, or startups
* Evidence you've built something — a project, a product, a business, a tool — where you owned the outcome, not just a task
* High agency. You don't wait to be told. You spot the gap and fill it.
* Product sense. You can reason about why a feature matters, not just what it does Common sense and sound judgment
* Comfortable talking to customers and holding your own in a demo or product conversation
* Structured thinking — able to break down a fuzzy problem into a clear plan
* Comfortable with data — reading metrics and dashboards to inform decisions
* Strong communication — with engineers, customers, and stakeholders, often in the same day


**What You'll Get**
* Direct mentorship and real ownership from day one — not a rotational or shadow role
* A front\-row seat to how an AI infrastructure product is actually built and sold
* Fast decision cycles — if you're right, we move; we don't wait on process
* Good compensation, in line with industry standards

**super.money** 
 , Indian’s fastest\-growing fintech, Flipkart\-backed platform processing over 300 million monthly transactions, is seeking a
 **Product Manager – Commerce** 
 . This Bangalore\-based, full\-time role offers the opportunity to lead the "zero\-to\-one" development of an Affordable Commerce vertical integrated into a high\-frequency UPI ecosystem.
 



  





**What You’ll Build (The Mission)** 



* **Product Strategy \& GTM:** 
 Define the end\-to\-end roadmap for Affordable Commerce, encompassing discovery, catalog design, checkout, and post\-purchase. Help deliver the vertical's P\&L and drive the go\-to\-market strategy to achieve product\-market fit among value\-conscious consumers.
* **Affordability \& Checkout Innovation:** 
 Integrate native Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) and EMI\-on\-UPI solutions into the checkout flow. Optimize financing options to reduce cart abandonment, increase Average Order Value (AOV), and enhance credit accessibility.

 Own the North Star metrics: Conversion Rate, AOV, Repeat Purchase Rate, and cart\-to\-checkout completion. Run continuous experimentation to build a self\-reinforcing commerce flywheel.

* 3–5 years in Product Management at high\-growth B2C startups, preferably in E\-commerce or Fintech.

 Zero\-to\-one experience; you have built a product, feature set, or vertical from scratch and taken it to measurable scale.

 Prior experience in Value/Social Commerce (e.g., Meesho, Shopsy) or exposure to fintech checkout lending (BNPL, EMI\-on\-UPI).

 You aren’t managing features; you’re building a business line.

 Instant access to an active base of 20M\+ users, backed by Flipkart’s 450M\+ shopper ecosystem.

 A seat at the table for one of the most strategic bets in super.money’s journey \- building a commerce vertical from scratch on India’s fastest\-growing UPI app.

For over 50 years, we’ve been connecting people to what matters most with low fares, legendary hospitality, and a heart for service. Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Writer at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll create clear, comprehensive documentation for complex scientific products and software platforms. Working in a collaborative environment, you'll make cutting\-edge technology accessible to customers across life sciences, healthcare, and research fields. This role offers the opportunity to blend technical expertise with creative communication skills while contributing to innovations that help make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
   

  

 The position offers remote work flexibility and focuses on developing high\-quality technical content across multiple formats, including user guides, API documentation, training materials, and product documentation. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams of scientists, engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts to translate complex technical information into clear, user\-friendly content that enhances the customer experience.
   

  

**Job Duties**
 Your contribution as Technical Writer relies on extensive experience in four chief functions:
   

  

**Develop and deliver technical content**
* Define content strategies and architecture at the portfolio level for sophisticated, specialized publications.
* Conduct interviews, research, observe, and work hands\-on to capture and synthesize source material.
* Architect customer\-facing content using a variety of multimedia options appropriate to specific purposes and audiences.
* Design and perform user research to define our audiences and evaluate the effectiveness of our team's work.


**Manage projects**
* Lead the implementation of new publication workflows and processes at our local site.
* Help develop, communicate, and manage project plans for new functional initiatives.
* Provide transparency to all elements of a project to leadership, collaborators, and resources.


**Analyze business processes**
* Collaborate on crafting solutions to improve our ways of working in support of our strategic vision and road map.
* Work with internal business partners to gather information, requirements, and priorities and provide input to our project planning and decision\-making processes.


**Mentor and coach teammates**
* Train and counsel less experienced technical communicators and project teammates on effective technical communication practices, departmental software, and our functional processes.


**Education**
 BS/BA in a writing\- or science\-related field, or the equivalent combination of experience and education.
   

  

**Experience And Knowledge**
* 12\+ years of technical writing experience.
* Professional experience in electron microscopy, life sciences, or related scientific field.
* Solid experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Sophisticated knowledge of structured authoring and single\-sourcing, particularly using Madcap Flare and other XML\-based authoring tools.
* Detailed experience with GitLab, HTML, and CSS.
* Successful project leadership in cross\-functional, cross\-cultural international work teams.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a history of developing positive relationships.
* Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
* Demonstrated attention to detail.
* Reliably self\-motivated and comfortable working independently.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: Business Analyst
 



  





 Location : Bengaluru
 



  





 No of Positions : 01
 



  





 About Signzy
 



  





 At Signzy, we’re solving for lasting first impressions and seamless new beginnings. Signzy is the market leader in digital banking infrastructure and helps you build trust without hassle. We offer digital onboarding, identity verification, and monitoring solutions across 180\+ countries through 340\+ APIs. Our APIs can be easily added to any workflow with simple widgets and help you with KYC, KYB, AML, fraud checks, bank account verification, and age verification. We work with over 10 Fortune 30 companies, all the largest banks in India, a Top 3 acquiring Bank in the US, and have a strong global partnership with Mastercard and Microsoft. Signzy has helped businesses like Stripe, HDFC, Paypal, Emirates NBD, and AmazonPay be more secure and globally compliant.
 



  





 About Role
 



  





 In the Business Analyst role we are looking for candidates who can work with technical teams and clients having an understanding of business processes as well as a basic understanding of SAAS product technologies.
 



  





 What you'll do:
 



  




* Understand the client’s Business requirements (Technical and System Integration related) and document them into a solution document.
* To read and analyze all the project requirement documents and understand what needs to be implemented.
* As\-is business requirement document, technical integration documents with flow chart diagram. Documentation to be enterprise\-level to represent the quality of deliverables.
* Ability to do gap analysis b/w systems \& APIs.
* Ability to test APIs and analyze the response and come up with FSD documents.
* Get the sign\-off on understanding documents from concerned stakeholders.
* Ability to understand and manage change requests from clients.
* Work closely with Clients, Project managers, Product Managers, and other BA, Configuration engineers \& other team members.
* Evaluate technical documentation, architecture, and solutions.
* Work with Dev and QA team for feature releases update.
* Have an understanding about the product development process and its cycles.
* Have an understanding of Sprint planning and its rituals.
* An ability to effectively communicate concepts and ideas to team members and clients.
* Can adapt well to changing circumstances and strategies.
* A commitment to understanding our clients and helping them deliver value.



  





 What you'll bring:
 



  




* Minimum work experience of 2 to 4 years.
* Must be from engineering background
* Good to have the BFSI Experience
* Basic understanding of SAAS product development and its technology stacks
* Basic knowledge of APIs and web services.
* Experience with multiple operating systems.
* Knowledge in networking and internet protocols.
* Exceptional attention to detailing any requirements.
* Excellent in verbal and email communication.
* Must have domain knowledge in BFSI/FinTech/RegTech.
* Confident in using Microsoft/google Package (especially Excel, google sheet/docs).
* Hands\-on experience in data manipulation and analysis.
* Preference for IIBA, CCBA, ECBA Certified candidates
