**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Business Systems Analysis \- Professional II
   

  

**What does a successful Power BI Developer do at Fiserv**
 We are looking for a Power BI Developer who can transform complex data into clear, compelling insights that support data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. In this role, you will design and deliver scalable business intelligence solutions, develop data\-rich dashboards and reports, and partner with business and technical teams to turn requirements into meaningful analytics outcomes.
   

  

 A successful candidate brings strong experience in Power BI development, data modeling, SQL querying, and reporting, along with the ability to communicate insights in a simple and actionable way.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand reporting and analytics requirements in a BI context
* Design data models that transform raw data into meaningful business insights
* Create interactive dashboards, visual reports, and scorecards using Power BI
* Develop data\-rich dashboards that support operational and strategic decision\-making
* Write DAX expressions and custom calculations to meet reporting and analytics needs
* Create paginated reports for structured and pixel\-perfect reporting requirements
* Implement row\-level security in Power BI to support secure and role\-based data access
* Identify and define key performance indicators with clear business objectives
* Analyze data and present insights through reports and dashboards that enable informed decisions
* Convert business requirements into technical specifications and support delivery planning
* Create relationships across datasets and develop tabular and multidimensional data models
* Document data flows, report logic, calculations, models, parameters, and relationships
* Design, develop, test, and deploy Power BI solutions and scripts
* Enhance and optimize existing business intelligence solutions through technical and strategic improvements
* Build customized charts, calculations, and visualizations based on business needs
* Work closely with users and cross\-functional teams to improve reporting performance and usability
* Apply best practices in BI design, development, governance, and continuous improvement


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 4\+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or other data\-focused roles
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with Power BI development
* Strong experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualizations in Power BI
* Experience writing DAX expressions and building custom calculations
* Experience creating paginated reports
* Experience implementing row\-level security in Power BI
* Strong knowledge of SQL querying and database management
* Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and OLAP concepts
* Experience translating business requirements into technical BI solutions
* Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical insights to non\-technical audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing custom business intelligence solutions
* Understanding of software development architecture and solution design
* Experience working in agile delivery environments
* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and reporting ecosystems
* Experience with Fiserv data sources and platforms such as MBM, Odessa, Snowflake, Optis, and Palantir


**Key Skills**
**Technical skills**
* Power BI dashboard and report development
* DAX and Power Query
* Paginated reporting
* Row\-level security
* SQL querying
* Data modeling
* Data warehousing
* OLAP
* Business intelligence solution development
* Data visualization and storytelling
* KPI design and performance reporting
* Documentation of models, logic, and reporting assets


**Professional Skills**
* Ability to interact effectively with both business and technical teams
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to simplify complex data into clear business stories
* Ability to learn quickly and respond to changing business needs
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Self\-motivated with a strong focus on continuous learning
* Ability to document processes, models, designs, and solutions clearly
* Team\-oriented with the ability to lead initiatives when needed


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
**About the Team**
 Come help us build the world's most reliable on\-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us further our 24x7, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's three\-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers.
   

  

**About the Role**
 The Data User Platform and Programs team works at the intersection of data infrastructure, reliability, governance, developer tooling and AI systems, supporting thousands of internal data users including engineers, analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders.
   

  

 This role is part of a founding engineering team in India, offering high ownership, strong growth opportunities, and direct influence over the platform's long\-term architecture.
   

  

 You will work on systems such as:
   

  

* Platform foundations for reliability, observability, cost\-efficiency and compliance
* A unified data discovery and catalog experience
* AI\-powered assistants and workflows for analytics and operations


 You will collaborate closely with product managers, data engineers, and analytics teams to deliver solutions that reduce friction and increase trust across the data ecosystem.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Improve scalability, performance, and reliability of data platform services through strong engineering practices
* Build and operate data discovery and metadata platforms that help users find the right datasets, dashboards, and metrics quickly and confidently
* Develop AI\-enabled services and workflows, including self\-serve tooling for creating, evaluating, and improving AI assistants
* Add observability, monitoring, and operational tooling to maintain platform SLAs and reduce incident response time
* Drive cost\-efficient data platform design by identifying underutilized, redundant, or idle datasets, services, and compute resources
* Embed cost awareness into the data lifecycle, including:
+ Designing systems that encourage reuse over duplication
+ Instrumenting usage and cost signals into platform services
+ Supporting safe deprecation and cleanup of stale data assets

* Partner with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-moving, product\-driven environment


**We're excited about you because…**
* B.E./B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or equivalent
* 3\+ years of experience with CS fundamental concepts and experience with at least one of the programming languages of Go, Java, and Python
* You have proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software
* Prior technical experience in Big Data infrastructure, Cost Efficiency \& Governance, you've built meaningful pieces of data infrastructure. Bonus if those were open\-sourced technologies like Spark, Clickhouse, Iceberg and Airflow
* Experience improving efficiency, scalability, and stability of data platforms
* Experience building or operating backend systems in production environments

title: Software Development Engineer- SDE1 (Backend)
description:
Location: Mumbai, MH
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s in CS / IT or related field


**About Purplle \& Our Mission**
 Purplle is more than a beauty e\-commerce destination; we are a technology\-first platform redefining how digital scale is managed. We are currently in a transformative phase, moving from “manual intervention and firefighting” to an era of Systematic Resilience.
   

  

 Our mission is to build “Unbreakable Systems”—platforms that don’t just survive failures but absorb them, self\-heal, and scale with the business calmly and predictably. We are looking for engineers who want to stop “fixing” and start “architecting” at the highest level.
   

  

 THE PURPLLE WAY: AI\-NATIVE ENGINEERING
   

  

 We Believe That As a Business Scales, Technology Shouldn’t Become More Fragile. We Have Redesigned Our Entire Engineering Lifecycle To Be AI\-native, Moving Away From Manual Toil Toward a World Of Intelligent, Self\-governing Systems
   

  

* Velocity without Fear (70% AI\-Assisted): We ship fast because we’ve built the safety nets to do so. You won’t just be a “coder”; you will be a system architect. We empower our engineers to use AI for the heavy lifting of development—aiming for 70% of Pull Requests to be AI\-assisted—so you can focus on complex logic and high\-level architecture.
* Built\-in Guardrails \& Self\-Healing Systems: Security and quality aren’t “extra steps”—they are baked into our “Golden Paths.” We build systems that use AI for automated rollbacks and deterministic fallback logic, ensuring the platform absorbs mistakes automatically and remains resilient under pressure.
* Intelligence by Default (Zero\-Toil Operations): We embed AI across the entire lifecycle—Build, Test, Detect, and Operate. By utilizing AI agents to eliminate “Ops Toil,” we’ve created an environment where anomaly detection and incident diagnosis happen in minutes, not hours.
* Predictable Economics \& Growth: We treat cloud costs and system performance as core engineering disciplines. Every engineer at Purplle understands the “unit economics” of their code, ensuring our infrastructure scales as efficiently as our business.


 THE PURPLLE ENGINEER: MINDSET \& IMPACT
   

  

 We Aren’t Looking For “feature Factories”; We Are Looking For Owners Of a Resilient Ecosystem. At Purplle, Your Success Is Defined By Your Mindset And The Tangible Impact You Have On Our Platform
   

  

 The Systems Thinker (Quality \& Resilience): You hate fixing the same bug twice. You’d rather build a “self\-healing” mechanism than perform a manual fix. Your goal is to maintain a Change Failure Rate of \<1\.5% and help us reach a state of fewer than 2 Sev\-1 incidents per quarter.The AI\-Fluent Architect (High Velocity): You are already using AI tools to 10x your own productivity. You leverage these tools to drive a cycle time of \<4 hours and maintain a high frequency of daily deployments, moving code from commit to production with total confidence.
 - The Data\-Informed Engineer (Economic Discipline): You care about the “why” behind the code. You understand that latency and cloud spend are engineering disciplines, and you optimize your infrastructure so that our cost\-per\-order remains predictable as we scale.

- The Proactive Collaborator (Security \& Governance): You thrive in a cross\-functional environment (Eng, Data, DevOps, Security). You take ownership of the “Golden Path,” ensuring 100% of your repositories are gated and that zero critical vulnerabilities ever reach our production environment.

 YOUR SPECIFIC MANDATE
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Be Directly Responsible For**
* AI\-Native Velocity: Lead the 70% AI\-assisted PR mandate by mastering Cursor, Copilot, and Claude to accelerate delivery of Node.js (NestJS) and Golang microservices—while keeping human intelligence focused on high\-level system design and architecture decisions.
* Unbreakable Backend Architecture: Architect high\-throughput, event\-driven microservices using Kafka and Redis, embedding resilience patterns like circuit breakers, health checks, and fallback mechanisms to handle massive traffic spikes without manual intervention.
* Data \& Performance Ownership: Own the ‘unit economics’ of the data layer—optimize MySQL and MongoDB queries, design efficient schemas, and ensure sub\-second p99 latencies with predictable infrastructure costs on GCP.
* End\-to\-End Golden Path Ownership: Drive features from design docs to Kubernetes deployment, ensuring high reliability through strong engineering practices and maintaining low change failure rates and minimal Sev\-1 incidents.
* API \& Service Design Excellence: Build clean, versioned, and backward\-compatible APIs and modular microservices with a strong focus on maintainability, scalability, and clear service contracts.
* Cloud\-Native Operations \& Observability: Design and operate services on Kubernetes with robust logging, monitoring, and alerting; proactively debug production issues and ensure high availability.
* Scalability \& Cost Efficiency: Continuously optimize system throughput, fault tolerance, and infrastructure utilization to support high growth while maintaining strict control over cloud costs.
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Lead design decisions, write clear RFCs, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and DevOps teams to drive high\-quality outcomes.
* Core Engineering Excellence: Apply strong fundamentals in distributed systems, concurrency, and data structures, combined with sharp problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills.


 TECH STACK
   

  

* Languages \& Frameworks: Node.js (NestJS / Express), Golang
* Data \& Messaging: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Aerospike, ElasticSearch
* Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GCP / AWS, Docker
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
* AI Productivity: Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot


**Experience**
* SDE1 — 1–3 years of backend engineering experience


 WHY JOIN PURPLLE TECH?
   

  

 You will be joining a team that is actively moving away from the “chaos” of traditional scaling. At Purplle, we are building a tech culture that is “Operational, not Aspirational.”
   

  

 We provide the tools, the AI\-first environment, and the “Golden Paths” to let you do the best work of your career. If you want to build intelligent, unbreakable systems that scale with confidence, your journey starts here.

title: Frontend Software Engineer (Web)

title: Freelance Full-Stack Web App Developer
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled
 **Full\-Stack Web App Developers (JavaScript/TypeScript \+ Python or Node)** 
 to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and build interactive browser\-based applications within our hybrid AI \+ human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot \- that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift \- you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide full\-stack engineering expertise, architectural judgment, and quality control to ensure web apps are functional, robust, and ready for real users. This part\-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end\-to\-end.
   

  

**What We Do**
 The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real\-world expertise from across the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full\-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser\-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini\-SaaS tools, and AI\-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data\-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express)
* Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores
* Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role\-based access where needed
* Integrate third\-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features
* Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly
* Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities)
* Evaluate AI\-generated full\-stack code and refactor it for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability
* Write clear, testable code and debug end\-to\-end issues across frontend, backend, and database


**Requirements And Benefits**
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in full\-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus
* Candidates should have a strong foundation in full\-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser\-based applications end\-to\-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and refine AI\-assisted output into production\-ready products. Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential
* Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar)
* Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS)
* Hands\-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design
* Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows
* Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, Fly.io, Railway, or similar)
* Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus
* Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos
* Self\-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently
* Portfolio of shipped web applications (required)
* English proficiency: Upper\-intermediate (B2\) or above (required)


**Project time expectations**
 For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10\-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.
   

  

**Compensation**
 On this project, contributors can earn up to
 **$35 per hour equivalent** 
 , depending on their level and pace of contribution.
   

  

 Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
   

  

**Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?**
* Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection. \-
* Gain hands\-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field
* Participate in performance\-based bonus programs that reward high\-quality work and consistent delivery

description:
BlueOptima is an engineering intelligence platform trusted by some of the world's largest banks, insurers, and enterprises. We give CTOs, CIOs, and engineering leaders the objective data they need to measure software engineering productivity, prove AI ROI, and reduce delivery risk.
   

  

 The conversation we sit in the middle of is one of the most pressing in enterprise technology right now. Every large organisation is rolling out AI coding tools and nobody can tell their board whether it is actually working. We can. Our research and our platform provide the answer, and we are building the commercial engine to get that message in front of the people who need to hear it.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer to help develop our scalable, data\-driven analytical dashboard. You'll focus on building responsive, user\-friendly interfaces that deliver key insights to our global clients. Join us and be a part of our mission to transform software development with cutting\-edge analytics.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Web & Mobile)
description:
**About Us**
 At Rhythm, our values form the foundation of our business. We are passionate about customer success, innovation, and our employees. They guide our actions, decisions, and interactions, ensuring that we consistently make a positive impact on the world around us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Company Overview
   

  

 Rhythm Innovations is an innovative startup specializing in fleet risk management. We are committed to drive customer delight through innovative solutions and a customer\-centric approach. As we continue to grow.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a versatile Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and ship features across our web, mobile, and backend applications. You will work with S3 , CloudFront , React , Vite , TypeScript , Tailwind on the web front end, and a mobile development framework (React Native preferred; Flutter also considered) to deliver consistent, high\-quality experiences across platforms.
   

  

 This is a cloud\-agnostic role: you will deploy and support applications on AWS, Azure and we value candidates who are comfortable working across at least one of these platforms and can pick up the others quickly. You will partner closely with product, design, and QA to take features from idea to production.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications using React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Amazon S3, and Amazon CloudFront.
* Build and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native; experience with Flutter will also be considered.
* Develop reusable business logic and platform\-appropriate user interfaces for both iOS and Android applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain secure RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs, including request and response contracts, authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling.
* Build responsive, accessible, and high\-performance user interfaces with a strong focus on component reusability, state management, and cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility.
* Develop scalable back\-end services using Node.js and Express.js.
* Design and work with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and DynamoDB.
* Perform database schema design, data modelling, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot applications on cloud platforms, with a primary focus on AWS.
* Work with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, DynamoDB, RDS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
* Write and maintain unit, integration, and end\-to\-end automated tests to ensure application quality and reliability.
* Participate actively in peer code reviews and follow established coding standards, security practices, and development guidelines.
* Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, designers, QA engineers, and other developers to translate requirements and mockups into working software.
* Provide early technical feedback on solution feasibility, dependencies, risks, and development effort.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline, or Google Cloud Build.
* Support frequent and reliable deployments to web environments and mobile application stores.
* Troubleshoot production issues across the complete technology stack, including UI rendering, mobile application behaviour, API failures, database performance, and infrastructure configuration.
* Monitor application availability, performance, logs, and errors, and take corrective action when issues are identified.
* Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions and recommend improvements to application scalability, security, maintainability, tooling, and developer experience.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, API specifications, deployment instructions, and implementation guidelines.
* Stay current with changes in front\-end, mobile, back\-end, and cloud technologies and recommend new tools, frameworks, or development patterns where they provide measurable value.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+ years of professional software development experience in a full\-stack or front\-end\-focused engineering role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Node.js for back\-end and API development using frameworks such as Express.js, Next.js, or similar technologies.
* Strong production experience with React and/or Vue.js, including:
+ Component\-based architecture
+ State management using Redux, Context API, Pinia, Vuex, or similar tools
+ React Hooks or Vue Composition API
+ Reusable and maintainable UI component development

* Experience building and releasing cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native; experience with Flutter, Ionic, or similar frameworks will also be considered.
* Working experience deploying, monitoring, and supporting applications on at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Willingness and ability to work across multiple cloud platforms when required.
* Practical experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, including:
+ Basic schema and data model design
+ Writing efficient queries
+ Indexing and query optimization
+ Database integration with back\-end services

* Good understanding of RESTful API design principles, authentication, validation, error handling, and API versioning.
* Exposure to GraphQL and GraphQL\-based API development will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with Git\-based development workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, and peer code reviews.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar platforms.
* Experience writing unit, integration, and end\-to\-end automated tests using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or equivalent frameworks.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work across front\-end, back\-end, database, mobile, and cloud layers.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve issues without relying on specialists for every layer of the application.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with TypeScript.
* Experience publishing and maintaining applications in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
* Exposure to containerization technologies such as Docker.
* Experience with serverless architectures using services such as AWS Lambda, Azure Functions.
* Familiarity with Amazon S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EC2, IAM, and CloudWatch.
* Knowledge of application security, performance optimization, logging, monitoring, and production support practices.


**Benefits**
 What We Offer
   

  

* The chance to own features end\-to\-end across web, mobile, and cloud at a growing startup.
* Collaborative and dynamic work environment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.

This position is an entry\-level opportunity for a graduate with a math background to apply their knowledge of probability, statistics and programming into a real\-world application and working in standard game analysis, strategy game analysis, and/or random number generator (RNG) analysis.

 We have been in the gaming industry for over 36 years but pride ourselves on looking forward. In addition to competitive salaries and benefits and the opportunity to engage with team members around the globe, we consistently invest in and support employee development so that you can continue to grow and succeed as you reach your full potential.

title: Regional Talent Acquisition Lead – APAC
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Regional Talent Acquisition Lead – APAC**

**Bangalore**

**Why join Rolls\-Royce?**

* At Rolls\-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.
* By joining Rolls\-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world\-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high\-performance culture.

**Summary**

This role is accountable for the delivery and evolution of Talent Acquisition service in region including Mid\-Careers and Early Careers delivery. Reporting to the Head of Talent Acquisition, you’ll work in partnership with the business, alongside TA Leads for other regions and outsourced providers to bring to life and operationalise TA strategy. You’ll be responsible for the supply \& demand relationship with our internal customers, overseeing the successful delivery of business\-critical hiring needs, and aligning employer branding to deliver business need for your region. Through these critical partnerships internally and in the external market you’ll bring expertise and insight and set the standards for best in market TA delivery and user experience.


**What you will be doing:**

* Regional Delivery: Accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of Talent Acquisition service for your region (APAC) across all employment categories (excluding Executive hires).
* Enterprise delivery: Work in collaboration with the global TA team, broader GBS teams and our supplier network to translate regional and divisional requirements into one Enterprise TA solution.
* Establish best in class benchmarks: Through effective vendor management and operational leadership, optimise the working partnership with our recruitment outsource provider and set the standards for best\-in\-class service provision.
* Vendor management: Closely monitor operational delivery and establish clear expectations with our vendors with regards best practice delivery. Where required you will implement and drive performance improvement programmes – working in partnership with our procurement teams to ensure we are receiving cost competitive, reliable and high performing support from our suppliers.
* Early Careers leadership: work as part of the Early Careers delivery team as the lead for Early Careers in region. You will translate regional hiring demand into an effective brand, attraction and selection strategy, help shape programme strategy for region, and ensure effective frameworks are in place to deliver required outcomes and optimise user experience
* Partnership across talent spectrum: Work in close partnership with the Executive Talent team to ensure consistency of brand and experience whilst optimising end to end delivery to ensure the talent flow from early career through mid\-career to “talent to value” roles is cohesive.
* Continuous improvement: Work as an integral part of the global TA team to oversee and shape technology, operational and process improvement projects for your region –achieving a balance of global consistency vs. regional need.
* Stakeholder Management: Manage regional stakeholders to ensure that they are ‘brought on the journey’ of Talent Acquisition services and its evolution.
* Transformation: Be the voice for your region in helping to shape the global evolution of TA, delivering local transformation improvements that can make our Talent Acquisition approach world class.
* Tech optimisation: Understand, evaluate, and leverage automation to ensure that our Talent Acquisition strategy is future\-proofed
* Innovate: Use innovative and creative solutions to address business challenges to address the challenges we face today and in pursuit of strategic goals
* Metrics and Reporting: Track recruitment metrics and analyse data to monitor global service delivery. Utilise insights to drive shape and drive improvement plans with suppliers, understand root cause issues, early identification of risk and monitor effective vendor delivery.
* Compliance and Diversity: Ensure compliance with local labour laws, regulations, and internal policies. Actively promote diversity and inclusion initiatives in the recruitment process \- ensuring all activity is aligned to the Diversity and Inclusion strategy and is woven into delivery plans.
* Financial management: in partnership with Head of Talent Acquisition oversee budget and spend for the region. This will include cost projections and budget setting, monitoring ongoing spend and management of invoicing, purchase orders and any required cross charging.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* Subject matter expertise in Talent Acquisition – knowledge of both Mid\-Career (experienced hire) and Early Career is essential
* APAC Geo (Specially India, Singapore) TA experience is mandatory
* Experience of operational leadership and demonstrable and effective vendor management
* Understanding of employment laws, regulations, and diversity/inclusion best practices.
* Experience in translating business strategy to operational demand and best in class delivery
* Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and metrics to drive decision\-making and process improvements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and senior leaders.
* Project delivery and change management experience

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi\-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls\-Royce into a high\-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company.


Join us, and it can be your future vision too. Rolls\-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non\-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.


As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

title: Security Manager - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About the job**


Citi Security \& Investigative Services (CSIS) is a corporate security function operating across more than 100 countries. We are responsible for the security and safety of Citi’s employees and facilities, and we lead Citi’s response during security incidents and crisis events. We value employees who will care about the wellbeing of our employees and will respond with urgency and a sense of ownership towards a diverse range of incidents.


Your main responsibility will be to manage and coordinate the security and safety services in Mumbai and Gujarat for all Citi businesses. The key goal of the position is to maintain a safe environment for clients, employees, to protect the company's assets and respond to security incidents. It also involves the protection of the company’s integrity and reputation.


You will be responsible for developing a local security program and procedures that conform to the Citi Security Policy and Citi Security Standards.


It will be your responsibility to ensure the program meets business requirements and local legal and regulatory requirements.


You will be responsible to design incident response plans and take the lead during physical security and safety incidents.


Your reporting line will be to the Director of Security \- India Subcontinent.


**What Does It Take to Be In This Role**


CSIS takes a risk\-based approach to security protection through implementing physical security measures and security systems which include access control systems, CCTV, and alarm monitoring, and is supplemented by security guarding where required.


The CSIS Security Lead Officer provides security support, guidance, and response to employees from various nationalities and diverse backgrounds.


This role requires the successful candidate to demonstrate high levels of professionalism and confident leadership as well as the ability to interact with senior leadership at Citi, and with external stakeholders such as vendors, local authorities, emergency services and law enforcement.


You will be required to perform regular on\-site reviews to verify the quality of compliance with requirements of the Citi Security Standards, procedures implemented and the standards of our Security Services during all operating hours at Citi Facilities.


**RESPONSIBILITIES** **(What You Will Be Working On)**


* Manage day\-to\-day security operations as well as security incident response, emergency response and crisis management support to the Crisis Management Team.
* Conducting Security Risk Assessments (SRA) for all Citi facilities in accordance with the requirements of the Citi Security Standards.
* Performing quality assurance and using penetration testing and operational readiness exercises as tools to ensure a high state of operational readiness.
* Perform security self\-audits and create and train Security and Safety Administrators to conduct security self\-audits at remote Citi facilities.
* Performing quarterly evaluations on security components and ensuring that any gaps identified through the process are remediated timely and escalated if needed.
* Collaborate with the facility Fire Safety team and support activities associated to requirements of the Fire Safety Procedures intended to ensure safety of Citi Staff.
* Acquiring and managing security vendor services in accordance with Procurement and Third\- Party Management policies and standards.
* Designing and implementing a facility security plan, including monitoring and implementing an Incident Response Procedure.
* Responding to security incidents, investigating incidents/breaches and reporting incidents via the Global Security Management System (GSMS).
* Participating in crisis management with a responsibility for People Safety and Security in partnership with HR, Enterprise Resiliency and other stakeholders.
* Meet the key performance metrics for your area of responsibility.
* Providing clear and concise briefings/advice to management on ongoing major security matters.
* Liaising with CSIS Intelligence, Law Enforcement, Public Private Partnerships, Industry Security Associations and the local ASIS and OSAC chapters to gather intelligence and information on security threats and respond to emerging threats.
* Producing evidence and deliverables as required by Internal Audit, Regulatory Examinators or authorized External Audits on security processes.
* Ensuring security equipment remains functional and current, and liaising with the CSIS Project Management and Technology Team to design replacement or new systems where required.
* Providing support to CSIS Executive Protection when required.
* Supporting visiting travelers during security events.
* Where required, preparing, and submitting licensing applications, security plans and other documentation required by regulators, law enforcement or industry standards organizations.
* Complying with local laws, rules and regulations on security and fire safety procedures.
* Conducting security risk assessments for significant events.
* Building and maintaining effective stakeholder relationships within the organization.
* Manage contingent and contract security staff at various Citi facilities. Ensure appropriate utilization of critical security resources including security guarding.
* Other tasks as assigned by the CSIS Leadership.

**EDUCATION \& PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** **(Tell Us What You’ve Got)**


* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant qualifications and/or apprenticeships/ vocational training programs.
* Relevant professional security qualifications or certifications will be an advantage.

**EXPERIENCE \& ATTRIBUTES** **(What We Are Looking For)**


* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant qualifications and/or apprenticeships/ vocational training programs.
* Professional security qualification or certification will be an advantage.

**EXPERIENCE \& ATTRIBUTES** **(What We Are Looking For)**


* Experience in security management in a corporate, regulatory, consultancy, security operations center, defense or law enforcement environment. However, serious consideration will be given to candidates without security management experience who possess strong audit, controls, risk or compliance capacity, or candidates with strong crisis management experience and geo\-political and international relations. (Required).
* Experience working in a corporate or financial services security team in a leadership role (Desired).
* A deep understanding of security operations, processes, and controls with demonstrated experience in designing a security program at facility level (Required).
* A strong understanding of applicable local laws/statutes as they relate to security (Required).
* Demonstration of verbal and written communication skills in English and fluency in one official local language. (Required).
* Proven experience of providing leadership in managing crisis events or significant security incidents. (Desired)
* Demonstrated ability to find agile solutions to manage a dynamic threat or risk (Desired).
* Knowledge of Operational Risk Management frameworks and regulations for the banking industry (Desired).
* An understanding of the security risks in the relevant cities and countries and the geo\-political risks that might impact the country. (Required)
* Demonstrate the ability to understand who the key internal and external stakeholders are, and how to build relationships and networks to manage stakeholder relationships. (Required)
* Ability to travel, often at short notice (Required).
* Ability to work at different offices within the city (Required).
* Ability to multitask by prioritizing and triaging multiple security incidents.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Demonstrates a desire to continually develop own skills.
* MS Office Word, Excel and Outlook proficiency and ability to adopt available AI tools.
* Demonstrates an appreciation of a diverse workforce.
* Willingness to take on feedback and adapt to CSIS methodologies.

The position may also require the successful candidate to take on additional roles and responsibilities within the India Subcontinent like managing the South Asia Command Center.

Corporate Services

--------------


Full time

------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.
\-

-------------------------

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

title: Associate Director - Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL
description:
**Job title:** **Associate Director – Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL**

 **Some careers have more impact than others.**


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Associate Director – Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Analyze data assets and generate insights aligned with business outcomes and strategic data models. Gather, understand data requirements from stakeholders to design and deliver analytics use cases (e.g. triggers). Deliver analytics PoCs that allow our businesses and clients to identify new opportunities. Responsible to address business challenges in an actionable way by leveraging current and emerging data and analytical techniques.
* Proactively identify opportunities to derive higher returns with improved Data Quality. Review and identify data inconsistencies across consuming systems. Responsible for providing management and direction to cross\-functional experts (pods) from analytics, technology, transformation and product management and key stakeholders across global functions and regions. Ensure implementation of consistent and effective management approach across the functional areas.
* Interface within the Detection Value Stream for all Change and Prioritization matters. Provide guidance and support to Leadership in the delivery of investment across technology, intelligence, and analytics to enhance the efficiency, effectiveness, security and cost profile of FC. Support and provide guidance in developing, driving and implementing programmes to quantify impacts and implement actions to address, manage and mitigate impacts of FC related regulatory changes across the FC control framework. Develop and Manage relationships with key internal stakeholders across Group functions, lines of business, regions, and countries.
* Facilitate the sharing of information and creation of feedback loops across the firm, with particular focus on wider FC Detection stakeholders to continuously adapt and improve change management and optimization. Overseas the support and coordination capability necessary to manage the response to high priority FC Detection Feedback requiring a coordinated response across Group Financial Crime functions, Compliance, lines of business, regions, or countries. Develop and maintain a strong and professional working relationship with Senior Management of FC, Risk, Audit and Finance at Business, Group and Regional levels
* Ensure appropriate timely and relevant risk information is provided to FC leadership and appropriate governance forums. Drive the articulation and embedding of FC Detection Optimization controls. Ensure that these are updated for changes in regulation and impacts on business. Resolve any identified issues promptly and escalate concerns to management as appropriate to ensure timely awareness of any material concerns.
* Maintain and observe all HSBC control standards and implement relevant policies, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal / external auditors and external regulators. Where required, support the articulation and embedding of framework, policies, procedures, and controls as they relate to FC Controls. Maintain awareness of operational risk within the value stream and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
* Develop and present options to implement controls whilst retaining full benefit from investment in systems. Clearly communicate and effectively implement the Change Management and Prioritization strategy to meet business needs. Provide direction at a global level and support at a regional level with respect to the FC Detection change and prioritization processes.
* Influence through action and strong leadership with respect to establishing an effective and efficient Risk Discovery Environment, deliver very strong collaboration and influencing across the Compliance matrix. Provide sponsorship and strategic vision for People Development initiatives aligned to Financial Crime, Compliance, and Group activities, as well as supporting the annual BAU HR cycle. Ensure effective communication across Financial Crime and the business to all key stakeholders in relation to FC Detection matters
* Support the sharing of developments and best practice across the wider FC Function. Support delivers the value stream approach aligned to detection outcomes to deliver a seamless integration of cross\-functional expertise. Maintain and develop positive and professional working relationships with senior business leaders, Risk and Compliance colleagues at Group, Regional and Market / Entity level
* Work effectively as part of a team, taking the lead where appropriate and contributing to team output and collaboration. Foster learning agile culture, promoting proactive review of lessons learned. Support an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects the HSBC brand. Ensures effective and open communication, team building, knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring not only within the function but to the broader organization

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong understanding of Global Financial Crime landscape and the various risk typologies and having good visibility to the eminent changes in landscape.
* Existing Financial Crime Detection capabilities and the limitations therein.
* Awareness of technological advancements in Financial Crime detection capabilities.
* HSBC is an extremely diverse business with significant geographical spread and activities that span a universal banking model, including continuing to innovate to keep abreast of changes in financial services markets globally. Such activity is in an increasingly regulated and complex global environment with often little consistency between laws and regulations in different jurisdictions and regulators taking a far more proactive approach in ensuring local compliance with their requirements and imposing increasingly stringent sanctions for breaches.
* The role will assist the Group in achieving a balance between the demands of regulators, external bodies and governmental initiatives and the Group’s shareholders and customers in enacting FC compliance; being alive to the political, management, regulatory and reputational implications of a particular decision and courses of action at a global level; assisting executive management in the development of controls and systems and influencing the way in which the business is conducted in order to manage these risks, meeting Group risk appetite. The increased focus on individual liability for senior managers, particularly Risk Heads, makes it increasingly important for the Group to be able to provide adequate systems and controls. The role is one where regulatory authority have high expectations and is likely to come under scrutiny as part of any major regulatory investigation.

 **You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

  

Hsbc.com/careers

  

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified people irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
description:
**Role description** **Who We Are:**



Vista’s CFO Organization empowers teams to focus on their domain and serve customers. Clear guardrails pave the way for strong engagement and efficiency in our lines of business, regional operations, and central functions. Team members work cross\-functionally, impacting every area of the company – from human resources, communications and real estate to finance, controllership, and legal services. The CFO team makes critical capabilities accessible, delivering services and information that every employee needs to succeed in their role.



Positioning ourselves centrally and globally, we offer opportunities to scale processes and ideas, facilitate feedback loops across Vista’s organizations and build a team of world\-class talent, with specialized skill sets.



**What You Will Do:**



Vista is building a world\-class finance organization, and we are seeking a highly motivated Senior Financial Analyst to join the FP\&A team. This role will have two main responsibilities –



* Provide finance support for one of our regions. Responsibilities include:


* Perform financial reporting and analysis including:
* Analyze and interpret data to understand key drivers of the financial results to drive actionable insights
* Prepare standardized reports and written analysis for weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews for finance leadership and other key stakeholders
* Drive reporting and process improvements with key users and stakeholders
* Drive our management reporting activities including:
* Drive the annual budget and forecasting processes
* Drive the month\-end close process including review of accounting entries, trends, and operating expenses
* Be a proficient user of Vista’s financial reporting tools
* Communicate across the global finance organization and corporate stakeholders
* Complete ad hoc analysis and other projects as needed.

2\. As a part of FP\&A Centre of Excellence


* Collaborate and work cross\-functionally to improve, standardize, and automate processes leveraging AI and other advanced tools.
* Utilize AI tools \& data visualization for business insights
* Proactively contribute to the team projects along with the regional requirements

This remote\-first position will be based in Bengaluru, India and report to FP\&A Manager.

  


**Your Qualifications:**



At Vista, we value the experiences that individual team members add to our culture. Please don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet the exact qualifications, we look forward to learning more about you!


* Previous experience working in a high performing team
* Ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast\-paced environment
* Intellectual curiosity and comfort driving progress independently
* Strong understanding of financial statements and profitability drivers
* Fluent in English and excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Experience with Data Visualization Tools (i.e. Tableau, Looker) and advanced Excel skills
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or similar field. CA preferred.
* 3\-5\+ years progressive work experience in FP\&A or similar field

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**



Being at Vista means that you dn’t see work as just a building, a desk, or a manufacturing floor. You see it as a chance to take a step forward in your career journey – and your life. We strive to give you everything you need to learn, grow, and succeed. Through innovation, collaboration, and perpetual exposure to what’s next, we are always pushing boundaries and broadening our horizons. We embrace the chance to operate outside of our comfort zone to discover what we are capable of. Some might call that a challenge; we just call it another great day at work.



Vista has received numerous recognitions including a perfect score of 100 on the Human Rights Campaign Foundation’s 2021 Corporate Equality Index (CEI) naming us a Best Places to Work for LGBTQ Equality. We also earned a place as one of the best remote\-first workplaces in the U.S. and on the Boston Best Places to Work list from Built In. In addition, Vista was recently honored with Comparably’s Best CEOs award according to employees. Vista offers numerous support systems including Employee Resource Groups like Pride, Mosaic, and Women in Technology, and special interest communities to foster awareness, respect, and inclusion within the workplace.



**We are Remote\-First:**



In 2020, Vista adopted a Remote\-First operating model and culture. We heard from our team members that having the freedom, autonomy, and trust in each other to work from home and the ability to operate when they are most productive, empowers them to be their best. Vista also provides collaboration spaces for team members to work physically together when it's safe to do so and when in\-person collaboration will deliver the best results. Currently we are enabled to hire remote team members in over 30\+ US States as well as several countries in Europe, including Spain, Germany, UK, Czech Republic, the Netherlands, Ireland and Switzerland.



**About Us:**



As an e\-commerce powerhouse, Vista creates customer value (and delight) through accessible, cutting\-edge technology. We are the marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For more than 20 years, we have helped small businesses look and feel credible through high\-quality marketing products and solutions that include signage, logo apparel, promotional products, face masks, flyers, postcards, business cards, websites and digital marketing. With Vista, small businesses are able to create and customize their marketing with easy\-to\-use digital tools and design\-templates, or by receiving expert graphic design support. In 2020, Vista acquired 99designs to expand its design offering via a worldwide community of more than 150,000 talented designers to make it easy for designers and clients to work together to create designs they love. Vista is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in\-store, online and on\-the\-go.



**Equal Opportunity Employer:**



Vista, a Cimpress company, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.

 **Skills**  

FP\&A, forecasting, data visualization tools

 **About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

title: Payroll Operations Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**


Executes end\-to\-end payroll processes for assigned countries or employee populations. Reviews and validates payroll inputs, ensures payroll accuracy and compliance with local legislation, responds to employee and stakeholder inquiries, and partners with internal teams and external payroll providers to deliver timely payroll services. Contributes to continuous improvement and standardization initiatives within the Managed Services organization.

**Job Description**

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll processes for assigned countries or employee populations in accordance with payroll calendars and service level agreements.
* Review and validate payroll inputs, including time and attendance, variable pay, employee data changes, and statutory deductions.
* Ensure payroll is processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with company policies and local legislative requirements.
* Review payroll reports and registers to identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll finalization.
* Partner with third\-party payroll providers to ensure accurate payroll processing and timely issue resolution.
* Respond to employee, manager, and stakeholder payroll inquiries, providing timely and professional support.
* Educate and support employees and managers on payroll processes, policies, and Time \& Attendance systems.
* Perform payroll audits and data validation activities to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Investigate payroll discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation as required.
* Maintain accurate payroll documentation and standard operating procedures for assigned countries.
* processes.

**Experience**

* Working knowledge of payroll operations, payroll legislation, tax, and social security regulations.
* Experience using payroll and HR systems.
* Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 2–4 years of payroll experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Support the implementation of new payroll policies, processes, and system enhancements.
* Contribute to payroll process simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, data privacy regulations, and statutory obligations.

title: Payroll Operations Manager
description:
**Role Summary**


The Payroll Manager is responsible for leading the delivery of high\-quality payroll services across multiple countries within a Managed Services environment. The role ensures payroll is processed accurately, on time, and in compliance with local legislation and company policies while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.


The Payroll Manager leads a team of 4–6 Payroll Specialists, providing coaching, performance management, workload planning, and technical guidance. The role also acts as the primary escalation point for payroll issues and collaborates closely with HR, Finance, vendors, and stakeholders.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll Operations**

* Lead the end\-to\-end payroll delivery for assigned countries
* Ensure payroll is processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with local legislation, tax, and social security requirements.
* Monitor payroll quality, service levels, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Review payroll results and resolve complex payroll issues and escalations.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and data privacy regulations.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4–6 Payroll Specialists.
* Set performance expectations and conduct regular performance reviews and development discussions.
* Allocate workload and manage team capacity to ensure service continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, customer\-focused, and high\-performing team culture.
* Support onboarding and training of new team members.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Act as the main escalation point for payroll\-related matters.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Time \& Attendance, Benefits, and external payroll provider to resolve issues.
* Communicate payroll updates, risks, and improvement initiatives to leadership.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, and efficiency.
* Lead or participate in payroll transformation and system implementation projects.
* Support standardization and automation initiatives across the Managed Services organization.
* Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.

**Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to payroll policies, procedures, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of payroll legislation and regulatory changes.
* Ensure compliance with SOX and other internal control requirements, where applicable.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Your role**
=============

**What you'll be doing**
========================

**What We Need**


Corpay is currently looking to hire a Human Resources Manager within our Human Resources department. This position is located in Nagpur, India. This position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence across the HR function by leading strategic HR operations initiatives, enhancing workforce analytics, and optimizing HR processes and systems. The ideal candidate is a data\-driven HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about improving the employee and manager experience through operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

**How We Work**


As a Human Resource Manager, you will be expected to work in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment, partnering closely with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and Centers of Excellence. Depending on business needs, this role may operate in a hybrid or onsite work environment.

**Role Responsibilities**


In this role, you will:

* Lead enterprise\-wide HR operations initiatives focused on automation, process optimization, workforce data governance, and compliance.
* Provide strategic workforce insights and recommendations to HR Business Partners and business leaders through advanced HR analytics and data interpretation.
* Oversee the delivery of HR reporting, dashboards, workforce metrics, and workforce planning inputs that support business decision\-making.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across HR systems, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve efficiency, scalability, and data accuracy.
* Partner with HR leadership on high\-impact organizational initiatives, including reorganizations, policy implementation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Establish and maintain governance processes that ensure HR data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology and automation to streamline HR operations and improve service delivery.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including HRIS, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, and IT to support enterprise HR initiatives.
* Develop executive\-ready reports and presentations that communicate workforce trends, operational performance, and strategic recommendations.
* Mentor and develop HR analysts while fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the HR organization.
**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
* 7\+ years of progressive HR Operations, HR Analytics, HRIS, or Human Resources experience.
* Experience leading HR operations, workforce analytics, or shared services functions in a complex, global organization.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate workforce data into actionable business insights.
* Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and workforce planning models.
* Demonstrated knowledge of HR compliance, governance, and HR data management best practices.
* Experience driving process improvement, automation, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Proven ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization and influence stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience working with enterprise HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or UKG is preferred.
 **Benefits \& Perks**

  

* Competitive salary package
* Career development opportunities in fintech
* Exposure to global clients and innovative payment solutions
* Health insurance and flexible work options
**About Corpay**
================

**About Corpay**

  

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.


At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.


As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre\-employment screening conducted by an authorized third\-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.

**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.


Learn more about Corpay: https://www.corpay.com

 **Transparency \& Compliance**

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**


Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.

 **Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring**


Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.

 **Candidate Privacy Notice**


For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy\-policy.

 **Pay Philosophy**


Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job\-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.
