title: Manager, Paid Media
description:
**About Learneo**  

Learneo is a platform of builder\-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

**About Quillbot**  

Quillbot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals—especially those learning English—strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, Quillbot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI\-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.


**Role Overview**  

We're seeking a data\-driven and strategic Manager for Paid Media to lead our paid marketing initiatives. This role is pivotal in driving scalable growth, optimizing media performance, and contributing to our full\-funnel marketing strategy. You'll work cross\-functionally with other Marketing teams, Data, Engineering, Product and Finance teams to improve our performance


**Responsibilities**


* Lead the Paid Media budget plan and allocation strategy across products, geos, languages, and channels, optimizing for Return on Investment and Lifetime Value
* Own end\-to\-end campaign strategy and execution across multiple platforms: Google Search, DV360, PMax, Meta, UAC, and ASA, among others. From strategy and setup to bid management and creative testing programs.
* Own audience strategy across the funnel, including segmentation, remarketing, and lookalike audiences, to maximize reach efficiency and conversion
* Define the measurement framework: own attribution infrastructure, incrementality testing, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) to ensure investment decisions are grounded in causal evidence. Work in close collaboration with the Data and Engineering team.
* Manage relationships with agencies, platform partnerships, and vendor agreements, including negotiations, renewals, and performance accountability
* Build, develop, and mentor the paid media team, set clear goals, improve ways of working, and create conditions for high performance
* Deliver regular performance reporting tied to business outcomes, CAC, ROAS, LTV, CPI, with clear recommendations for leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Continuously evaluate and pilot emerging ad formats, AI\-powered campaign types (incl. AI Max), and platform innovations to keep the paid media function ahead of market shifts
* Articulate the investment plan and performance results in structured presentation and reporting formats
* Run structured A/B tests across ads, landing pages, and bidding strategies; translate results into scalable improvements
* Build and manage a global affiliate program, designing commission models that drive incremental sales
* Partner with Data, Product, Finance, and Legal to align paid media investments with broader growth and profitability goals


**Qualifications**


* 7\-12 years in Paid Media, Growth Marketing and Performance Marketing.
* Full\-funnl campaigns and global media strategies knowledge
* Proven track record managing large\-scale paid campaigns across multiple channels
* Strong analytical mindset with expertise in attribution, media mix modeling, incrementality and full\-funnel metrics
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams with strong bias to negotiation and peer influence
* Comfortable with data platforms, dashboards, and a hands\-on approach to tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, DV360, GA4, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker
* Experience with Affiliate marketing
* Background on DTC and B2C. Previous experience on subscription\-based business models desired.
* Managerial experience with remote teams
* Experience on selecting and managing Media Agencies overseas
* Familiarity with AI and writing tools is a bonus.


**Benefits \& Perks**


* Competitive salary and annual bonus
* Medical coverage
* Life and accidental insurance
* Vacation \& leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
* Developmental opportunities through education \& developmental reimbursements \& professional workshops
* Maternity \& parental leave
* Hybrid \& remote model with flexible working hours
* On\-site \& remote company events throughout the year
* Tech \& WFH stipends \& new hire allowances
* Employee referral program
* Premium access to Quillbot


* Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

title: IT&D Manager, Service Delivery
description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.**Information Technology \& Digital**
-------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  

  

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  

  

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.**About the role**
------------------



The IT\&D Manager, IT Service Delivery is accountable for the end\-to\-end service delivery, operational performance, and continual improvement of IT applications and services aligned to a defined Business Capability Stream (e.g. HR, Finance, ERP, Supply, Marketing, R\&D) within a predominantly outsourced operating model.



This role acts as the single point of accountability for service outcomes, ensuring that strategic service providers deliver stable, resilient, secure, and business\-aligned services that meet agreed SLAs, XLAs, and contractual commitments. The role serves as the primary business\-facing IT partner, translating business priorities into operational requirements and orchestrating internal IT teams and multiple suppliers to deliver seamless, high\-quality services.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------



1\. End\-to\-End Service Accountability  

* Own the end\-to\-end operational performance of all applications and services within the assigned capability stream, regardless of supplier or delivery tower.
* Act as the business\-facing service owner, accountable for availability, reliability, performance, and user experience.
* Ensure services are operated as integrated end\-to\-end value streams, not disconnected vendor silos.

  

2\. Supplier \& SIAM\-Oriented Service Orchestration  

* Lead and govern strategic managed service providers, SaaS vendors, and system integrators delivering application and service support.
* Operate as part of a SIAM\-style model, ensuring clear RACI, handoffs, and collaboration across multiple suppliers.
* Hold suppliers accountable for outcomes, not effort, including SLA performance, incident quality, proactive problem prevention, and continuous improvement.

  

3\. Service Performance \& Governance  

* Define, manage, and continuously improve SLAs, XLAs and KPIs aligned to business priorities and critical business events.
* Ensure transparent, accurate, and meaningful reporting focused on:


o Business impact  

o Service stability  

o User experience  

o Root cause and trend insights  

  

4\. Stakeholder \& Business Relationship Management  

* Serve as the primary IT service delivery partner for senior stakeholders within the aligned capability stream.
* Translate business demand, priorities, and pain points into service delivery objectives and supplier commitments.
* Proactively communicate service health, risks, and improvement actions using clear, business\-focused language.
* Represent operational readiness, risk, and service impact in business governance forums.

  

5\. Incident, Major Incident \& Problem Management  

* Ensure robust incident and major incident management across suppliers, including escalation, coordination, and communications.
* Drive Problem Management discipline across vendors, ensuring root causes are identified, recurring issues eliminated, and permanent fixes delivered.
* Hold suppliers accountable for preventable incidents and repeat failures.

  

6\. Change, Release \& Service Transition Oversight  

* Govern supplier\-led change and release activities to balance speed, stability, and risk.
* Accountable for service transition readiness for new systems, enhancements, or supplier changes, including:


o Support models  

o Knowledge transfer  

o Runbooks  

o Monitoring and alerting  

o Service desk enablement  

  

7\. Operational Risk, Resilience \& Compliance  

* Identify and manage service delivery risks across suppliers, including capacity, resilience, security, and compliance.
* Ensure services adhere to internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.

  

8\. Continual Improvement, Automation \& Efficiency  

* Use incident, problem, and performance data to prioritise improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation, simplification, and standardisation across suppliers to:


o Reduce manual effort  

o Improve stability  

o Lower run costs  

o Enhance user experience  

  

9\. Financial \& Contractual Management (Run Services)  

* Manage run\-state costs associated with the service portfolio, including vendor spend and support contracts.
* Ensure cost transparency and value\-for\-money from service providers.
* Support commercial governance, contract compliance, and service demand prioritisation.
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Proven experience leading IT service delivery in an outsourced or SIAM\-based environment.
* Strong expertise in ITIL\-based service management (incident, problem, change, service transition, service level management).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple suppliers and drive end\-to\-end service outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with senior business leaders.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP, Siebel, SuccessFactors, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM).
* Financial and vendor commercial management experience.
* Exposure to automation, observability, and modern operations practices (AIOps concepts).
* Deep hands\-on experience with ServiceNow as the enterprise IT Service Management platform, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management.
* Understanding of ServiceNow CMDB, service mapping, and dependency modelling to enable true end\-to\-end service ownership.
* Experience defining and governing ITSM workflows, SLAs/XLAs, dashboards, and reporting within ServiceNow, and using ServiceNow data and insights to drive operational performance, problem reduction, and continual service improvement.

  

What Success Looks Like  

* Stable, predictable services with minimal business disruption
* Suppliers operating as one integrated service ecosystem
* Reduced incident volumes and repeat issues
* Clear service ownership and accountability
* Improved business satisfaction and trust in IT delivery
**The skills for success**
--------------------------



Service Delivery, IT Operations, SIAM, ITIL

**What we offer**
-----------------

We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. **Manager \- Procurement Operations \& Advisory (WBPPS)**

**Preferred Language(s):**

**Description**

**Note: Subject to business needs and management approval, the location for this position will either be Sofia, Bulgaria, Chennai, India or Washington, DC**


The World Bank Group is a unique global partnership of five institutions driven by a bold vision to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. As one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries, we help solve the world’s greatest development challenges. When you join the World Bank Group, you become part of a dynamic, diverse organization with 189 member countries and 182 offices worldwide. We work with public and private sector partners, invest in groundbreaking projects, and use data, research, and technology to bring tangible and transformative change around the globe. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org


**Vice\-Presidency Context**


The WBG Budget and Procurement (WBP) is organized into five Departments: WBP Centers of Excellence (WBPCE) with teams supporting the corporate strategic business and budget planning process, providing WBP systems, knowledge, and shared services; WBP IBRD/IDA Regional Units (WBPRU) with teams supporting IBRD/IDA clients in the regions; WBP IFC/MIGA Budget Partners (CSRDR) with teams supporting IFC/MIGA clients in the HQ and the regions; WBP Corporate Units (WBPCU) with teams supporting the Knowledge Bank and corporate units and providing capital budget support; and WBP Corporate Procurement (WBPCP) with teams providing group\-wide procurement services.


**Unit Context**


Steps to continue evolving the management structure of WBPCP with its strategic priorities present the opportunity to recruit for an expanded managerial role in the Department. In line with the WBP global footprint strategy and delivery model, the location of the positions may be Washington D.C., Chennai, or Sofia. In accordance with World Bank Group policy, positions in Country Offices, irrespective of level, are subject to local recruitment. Selections to positions outside of Washington D.C. will be LRS. Business needs and candidate preference will be considered in determining the actual location of each of the positions described below:


Manager, Procurement Operations \& Advisory is responsible for all operational and advisory functions within the Corporate Procurement department. These include the Corporate Procurement Service Desk, Order Management, Vendor Management, governance monitoring, systems support and administration, and regional procurement advisory, amongst others. Manages a global team of 35 staff based in the HQ, Global Business Centers (GBC), and in each of the seven regions of the WBG to support the decentralized footprint of WBG clients.


**Duties and accountabilities:**


Manager, WBPPS has the following three areas of responsibility:


**A)Business Management Responsibilities**


* Manage the teams providing planning, budgeting, and performance reporting services; conducting analytical work and providing advisory services in areas of focus (e.g., operations, investments in technology); and providing other services as needed over time.


* Is an active member of the WBP Leadership Team, participates in cross cutting activities, and from time to time, takes on leadership roles in WBP\-wide activities, such as recruitment and other HR initiatives.


* Provides support and advice to the Vice President and the Director of WBP, Corporate Procurement as requested.


**B)Talent Management Responsibilities**


* Manages the unit staff, including recruitment, evaluation, and career development of staff.


* Provides leadership and support to her/his staff to build sustainable finance skills and capacity to effectively deliver WBP services.


* Manages and oversees the engagement and evaluation of technical consultants within the WBPCP unit, as needed.


**C)Budget Management Responsibilities**


* Effectively and efficiently manages his/her unit’s resources, ensuring its effective formulation and input into budget decisions.


* Advocates and drives cost\-effective delivery of business finance services, promoting transparency, simplicity, standardization, and automation.

**Selection Criteria**


The successful candidate should be recognized for an ability to get things done, strategic thinking and execution leadership, reputation and track record leading large business transformation initiatives, being a problem\-solver, and possessing accomplishments relevant to the WBG’s strategic agenda.


The successful candidate will have an active interest in the activities of the World Bank Group, its mission, products and services in addition to having a strong work ethics and unquestionable integrity, and should possess strong leadership in multicultural environment, and analytical abilities as well as excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills adaptable to all audiences, including Board level.


The candidate should have a minimum of a Master’s degree in relevant field/discipline (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, etc.), coupled with a minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in procurement, with a strong track record of success in leading and managing complex procurement operations.


The ideal candidate should also possess as many of the following professional and personal characteristics as possible:


* Deep understanding of procurement principles, practices, and regulations, including international procurement standards.


* Strong strategic orientation and ability to manage successfully large work programs and extensively decentralized teams.


* Demonstrated ability to conceptualize complex issues with future focused systematic thinking and frame problems as actionable issues with ability to develop consensus among diverse constituents.


* Proven ability to balance client concerns with wider corporate concerns as well as proven ability to interact effectively with WBG and external counterparts.


* Proven change integrator with ability to effectively lead and implement complex change management initiatives.


* Strong understanding of the workings of the organizational context including the matrix environment with deep functional knowledge of the challenges of resource deployment in Operations.


* Demonstrated effectiveness in collaboration across the Organization including Operations and Corporate functions and proven ability to build common goals and solutions while managing different views.


WBG Managerial Competencies

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


World Bank Group Core Competencies

title: Vessel Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.

**Position Description:**



The Vessel Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and economical operation of assigned vessels. The position applies knowledge of engineering, HR\-management, shipping\-industry regulations, commercial and legal considerations, and guides sea\-staff onboard assigned vessels. The Vessel Manager also takes initiative to continuously improve the performance of assigned ships and strengthens the teamwork between ship and office.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


* To be familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members either of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Guides, advises, and monitor vessel operations; also assists crew performing vessel maintenance
* Researches technical information related to equipment breakdowns, malfunctions, improvements, upgrades or modifications for the reliable long\-term performance of the vessels
* Prepares for scheduled dry dockings, surveys and repairs on assigned ships, and arranges and manages supply of spares, stores, and services to vessels before scheduled maintenance and breakdown repairs
* Manages vessels in full compliance with local and international rules and regulations; and with Seaspan’s Safety Management System (SMS)
* Analyses ships’ performance and relays this information to the onboard master and chief engineer; ensures compliance with current charter\-party terms of employment and other commercial concerns
* Ensures compliance with all necessary operational certification and survey requirements applicable to assigned vessels
* Visits vessels port; may sail with Seaspan ships to reasonably ascertain that they are operated in a safe, reliable and economical way
* Monitors function and performance during ship visits and initiates effective problem solving of on\-board issues, including technical, quality\-assurance, health and safety, commercial or personnel issues
* Takes ownership of on\-board issues and follows them through to resolution
* Prepares budgets in the required detail for the yearly operation of assigned ships, scheduled dry dockings, surveys, repairs and ad\-hoc modifications and repairs within required timelines
* Monitors expenses of assigned vessels and submits monthly variance reporting and tracks against budget
* Ensures that all reporting employees adhere to company policies and procedures
* Communicates expectations to direct reports; manages performance and provides leadership and support to team members
* Demonstrates commitment to Seaspan’s Maritime Resource Management values
* Performs other duties as required

  


**Requirements:**


* Must have at least one year of experience as a technical superintendent in a company managing handy\-max sized (or larger) vessels engaged in international trading and must have a minimum of one full year in rank as a chief engineer orhave completed three contracts as a chief engineer with Seaspan
* English language skills, both verbal and written, must be effective and suitable for a multi\-cultural working environment
* Strong technical knowledge
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* Class 1 marine engineer certificate
* Degree in marine engineering or equivalent

  

  

**Additional Desired Qualifications:**


* Experience working with container ships
* Education in mechanical engineering or naval architecture
* Previous experience with new\-builds and dry\-dockings preferred

  


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**


* Regular international travel is required and may be on short notice
* Must have mobility to conduct vessel inspections
* Will be required to carry a mobile device and check regularly outside of office hours
* Must maintain a home internet connection for work outside of office hours


Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
**RemoFirst** is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all\-in\-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

We are a small but strong team of 200\+ people (and growing) hyper\-focused on delivering a world\-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry\-leading partnerships.  



We are seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to optimize and scale our revenue operations across the full customer lifecycle. Reporting at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Partnerships, this role will own key operational processes including CRM administration, sales compensation, reporting, enablement, and revenue systems. You will drive process improvements, support strategic initiatives, and ensure our revenue teams have the tools, processes, and insights they need to succeed.



This is a highly cross\-functional role requiring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment.



### **Key Responsibilities**


* Partner with Sales, SDR, and Partner teams to optimize CRM workflows, improve sales processes, administer PandaDoc, support revenue tools, and execute cross\-functional operational initiatives.
* Own the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the CRM, ensuring data integrity, process consistency, and user adoption.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
* Design and deliver monthly Sales Enablement training sessions in partnership with Sales leadership, including topic selection, presentation development, and training delivery.
* Own the monthly sales commission calculation process within Remuner, ensuring accuracy and compliance with compensation plans.
* Partner with the Finance team to ensure timely and accurate commission disbursements.
* Own the Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) reporting process and prepare recurring management reports to provide visibility into revenue performance.
* Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports that support sales performance, pipeline visibility, forecasting, and executive decision\-making.
* Support ad hoc Request for Proposal (RFP) responses and other strategic initiatives as needed.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Account Executives and other revenue team members on CRM, compensation, sales tools, reporting, and operational processes.
* Collaborate across Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Leadership to document, standardize, and continuously improve revenue operations processes.
### **What you'll need:**


* 5–10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Sales Compensation, CRM Administration, or a related field.
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into operational improvements.
* Experience administering CRM platforms and supporting revenue technology stacks.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex processes clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes, automate workflows, and drive operational efficiencies.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
### **Nice to have:**


* Experience with Employer of Record (EOR), Professional Employer Organization (PEO), or contractor management platforms.
* Experience with HubSpot CRM, PandaDoc, Apollo, and business intelligence (BI) tools.
* Experience administering or managing commission software such as Remuner.
* Familiarity with SaaS business models and recurring revenue metrics, including Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), and customer lifecycle reporting.
### **Why work at RemoFirst?**


* **Startup environment.** RemoFirst is an early\-stage start\-up. You have a voice, and can influence and grow rapidly.
* **Build \& Scale From Scratch.** Experience hyper\-growth scale and help us build a great team of professionals worldwide that can help us achieve this ambitious vision.
* **Work for a Market Leader.** Scale a project that counts market\-leading companies like Microsoft, Mastercard, and more as happy customers.
* **Compensation and perks are great!** Competitive compensation. 100% remote work. PTO regulated by local statutory.
* **Culture.** We lead with respect, kindness, and the right to fail. We value hard, yet smart work. Diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA. As we grow and evolve, we welcome your input to help us define our culture further.

  


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About the Role

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day HR processes, ensuring compliance with company policies and statutory regulations, maintaining employee records, and delivering a seamless employee lifecycle experience. The role requires strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll coordination, attendance management, HRMS, and statutory compliance.

Key ResponsibilitiesHR Operations

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities.
* Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and personnel files in the HRMS.

Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor employee attendance, shift schedules, leave records, and regularization requests.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve attendance\-related issues.

Payroll Coordination

HRMS Administration

* Generate HR reports, dashboards, and MIS as required by management.

Statutory Compliance

* Coordinate with external consultants and government authorities whenever required.

Employee Relations

* Support employee engagement initiatives and HR communication.
* Ensure implementation of HR policies and procedures across the organization.

Exit Management

* Coordinate employee resignations, exit interviews, No Dues clearance, and Full \& Final Settlement.
* Ensure timely completion of separation formalities and documentation.

Reporting \& Documentation

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR MIS reports.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR records.
* Assist in HR audits and process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Experience

* Minimum **4 years** of experience in HR Operations.
* Experience working with HRMS, payroll processes, attendance management, and statutory compliance.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

VJX Research is a New Delhi\-based family office investment firm being built from the ground up. To start, our primary focus is listed Indian equities\-mid, small, and micro\-cap names\- with unlisted opportunities becoming a larger part of the mandate over time. * Include 1–2 micro\-cap names a month as part of your coverage

* Build your own network with company management over time, and help identify and coordinate meetings for the founder
* Stay genuinely engaged with markets broadly\-reading widely and contributing your own ideas and perspective, not just executing assigned coverage

* Real intellectual curiosity and the ability to think and write clearly
